title.en: A string length that respects a limit
title.zh: 带上限的字符串长度

prompt.en:
Write `size_t text_len(const char *s, size_t max)`.

It returns the number of characters in `s` before the first '\0'. It must never look at more than `max` characters. If there is no '\0' among the first `max` characters, return `max`.

Assume `s` is not NULL. Do not call library functions.
prompt.zh:
编写函数 `size_t text_len(const char *s, size_t max)`。

它返回 `s` 中第一个 '\0' 之前的字符个数，但最多只能查看 `max` 个字符。如果前 `max` 个字符里没有 '\0'，就返回 `max`。

假设 `s` 不是 NULL。不要调用库函数。

text.en: The loop tests `n < max` before it reads `s[n]`, so the limit is never crossed.
text.zh: 循环先判断 `n < max` 再读取 `s[n]`，所以绝不会越过上限。

text.en: The loop stops at the first '\0'.
text.zh: 循环在遇到第一个 '\0' 时停止。

text.en: It returns the count, and returns `max` when no terminator appears (including `max == 0`).
text.zh: 返回计数；当没有终止符时返回 `max`（包括 `max == 0` 的情况）。

mistakes.en: Writing `s[n] != 0 && n < max`. The order matters: the read of `s[n]` can already be one step past the allowed range.
mistakes.zh: 写成 `s[n] != 0 && n < max`。顺序很重要：读取 `s[n]` 时可能已经越过了允许的范围。

mistakes.en: Using `n <= max`, which can return `max + 1`.
mistakes.zh: 使用 `n <= max`，结果可能是 `max + 1`。

mistakes.en: Calling `strlen`. It ignores `max` and runs on through a buffer that has no terminator.
mistakes.zh: 直接调用 `strlen`。它不理会 `max`，遇到没有终止符的缓冲区会一直读下去。

mistakes.en: Counting the terminator, so the answer is one too large.
mistakes.zh: 把终止符也算进去，结果多 1。

title.en: Copy a string into a small buffer
title.zh: 把字符串复制进小缓冲区

prompt.en:
Write `size_t copy_text(char *dst, size_t cap, const char *src)`.

`dst` points to a buffer of `cap` bytes. Copy as many characters of `src` as fit, and always leave `dst` ending in '\0' when `cap > 0`. When `cap` is 0, write nothing at all.

Return the length of `src` (the number of characters before its '\0'), even if the copy was cut short. A caller can then detect a cut copy by testing `result >= cap`.

Assume `dst` and `src` are not NULL. Do not use `strcpy`, `strncpy` or `strlen`.
prompt.zh:
编写函数 `size_t copy_text(char *dst, size_t cap, const char *src)`。

`dst` 指向一块 `cap` 字节的缓冲区。尽可能多地把 `src` 的字符复制进去；当 `cap > 0` 时，`dst` 末尾必须是 '\0'。当 `cap` 为 0 时，什么都不能写。

返回 `src` 的长度（其 '\0' 之前的字符个数），即使复制被截断也要返回完整长度。这样调用者可以用 `result >= cap` 判断是否被截断。

假设 `dst` 和 `src` 都不是 NULL。不要使用 `strcpy`、`strncpy` 或 `strlen`。

text.en: Never copies a character to `dst[cap - 1]` or beyond: the copy stops one byte early so the terminator fits.
text.zh: 复制的字符绝不写到 `dst[cap - 1]` 及其之后：复制提前一个字节停止，给终止符留位置。

text.en: When `cap > 0` it always writes a '\0', also when the text was cut.
text.zh: 当 `cap > 0` 时总会写入 '\0'，文本被截断时也一样。

text.en: When `cap == 0` it writes nothing (no terminator either).
text.zh: 当 `cap == 0` 时什么都不写（连终止符也不写）。

text.en: It returns the full length of `src`, not the number of characters copied.
text.zh: 返回 `src` 的完整长度，而不是实际复制的字符数。

text.en: The loop is driven by the '\0' of `src`, so the length is right for texts longer than the buffer.
text.zh: 循环由 `src` 的 '\0' 控制，所以文本比缓冲区长时长度依然正确。

mistakes.en: Writing the terminator at `dst[n]` without checking `n < cap`: a long text then overflows the buffer.
mistakes.zh: 不检查 `n < cap` 就在 `dst[n]` 写终止符：文本很长时会写出缓冲区。

mistakes.en: Copying `cap` characters. That leaves no room for the \0, so the buffer is not a valid string.
mistakes.zh: 复制了 `cap` 个字符。这样没有位置放 \0，缓冲区就不是合法字符串。

mistakes.en: Returning the number copied. The caller then cannot tell a cut copy from a complete one.
mistakes.zh: 返回已复制的个数。这样调用者无法区分被截断的复制和完整的复制。

mistakes.en: Computing `cap - 1` when `cap` is 0. With an unsigned type this wraps to a huge number.
mistakes.zh: 在 `cap` 为 0 时计算 `cap - 1`。无符号类型会回绕成一个巨大的数。

title.en: Reverse a string in place
title.zh: 原地反转字符串

prompt.en:
Write `void reverse_text(char *s)`.

`s` points to a writable, '\0'-terminated string. Reverse the characters before the '\0' in place, using no second buffer. The '\0' must stay where it is.

For example "stressed" becomes "desserts". The empty string and a one-character string stay unchanged.
prompt.zh:
编写函数 `void reverse_text(char *s)`。

`s` 指向一个可写的、以 '\0' 结尾的字符串。就地反转 '\0' 之前的字符，不能使用第二个缓冲区。'\0' 必须留在原位。

例如 "stressed" 变成 "desserts"。空字符串和单字符字符串保持不变。

text.en: Finds the length by scanning for '\0' (or with `strlen`).
text.zh: 通过扫描 '\0'（或调用 `strlen`）得到长度。

text.en: Swaps pairs from the two ends towards the middle, and stops when the two positions meet. Each pair is swapped once.
text.zh: 从两端向中间成对交换，两个位置相遇时停止。每一对只交换一次。

text.en: Only characters before the '\0' move: the last index is `n - 1`, never `n`.
text.zh: 只有 '\0' 之前的字符会移动：最后一个下标是 `n - 1`，不是 `n`。

text.en: The empty string and one-character string are safe (no `n - 1` wrap-around, no swap).
text.zh: 空字符串和单字符字符串是安全的（没有 `n - 1` 的回绕，也没有交换）。

mistakes.en: Using `s[n]` as the right end. That swaps the \0 to the front and the string becomes empty.
mistakes.zh: 把 `s[n]` 当作右端。这会把 \0 换到最前面，字符串变成空串。

mistakes.en: Looping `i < n` instead of stopping at the middle. Every pair is swapped twice and nothing changes.
mistakes.zh: 循环到 `i < n` 而不是在中点停止。每一对被交换两次，结果没有变化。

mistakes.en: Computing `n - 1` with a `size_t` when `n` is 0. The result wraps to a huge index.
mistakes.zh: `n` 为 0 时用 `size_t` 计算 `n - 1`。结果会回绕成巨大的下标。

mistakes.en: Trying to reverse a string literal such as `char *s = "abc"`. A literal is read-only; the caller must pass an array.
mistakes.zh: 试图反转 `char *s = "abc"` 这样的字符串字面量。字面量是只读的，调用者必须传入数组。

title.en: Swap through pointers
title.zh: 通过指针交换

prompt.en:
Write two functions.

1. `void swap_int(int *a, int *b)` swaps the two integers the pointers point to. It must also work when `a` and `b` are the same pointer: the value must stay unchanged.
2. `void sort2(int *lo, int *hi)` makes `*lo <= *hi` true. It swaps the two values only if they are out of order, and it must call `swap_int`.

Assume the pointers are not NULL.
prompt.zh:
编写两个函数。

1. `void swap_int(int *a, int *b)`：交换两个指针所指向的整数。当 `a` 和 `b` 是同一个指针时它也必须正确：值保持不变。
2. `void sort2(int *lo, int *hi)`：使 `*lo <= *hi` 成立。只有两个值顺序不对时才交换，并且必须调用 `swap_int`。

假设指针都不是 NULL。

text.en: `swap_int` reads both values through the pointers and writes them back crossed, using one temporary `int`.
text.zh: `swap_int` 通过指针读出两个值，再交叉写回，使用一个临时 `int`。

text.en: It is correct when `a == b` (no XOR or add/subtract trick that zeroes the value).
text.zh: 当 `a == b` 时也正确（不使用会把值变成 0 的异或或加减技巧）。

text.en: `sort2` compares `*lo` and `*hi` (values, not pointers) and calls `swap_int(lo, hi)` only when `*lo > *hi`.
text.zh: `sort2` 比较的是 `*lo` 和 `*hi`（值而不是指针），只有 `*lo > *hi` 时才调用 `swap_int(lo, hi)`。

mistakes.en: Swapping the parameters themselves (`int *t = a; a = b; b = t;`). Only the local copies of the pointers change.
mistakes.zh: 交换参数本身（`int *t = a; a = b; b = t;`）。改变的只是指针的局部副本。

mistakes.en: The XOR swap `*a ^= *b; *b ^= *a; *a ^= *b;`. When both pointers are the same, the first step makes the value 0.
mistakes.zh: 使用异或交换 `*a ^= *b; *b ^= *a; *a ^= *b;`。两个指针相同时，第一步就把值变成了 0。

mistakes.en: Comparing `lo > hi`, which compares addresses, not the integers.
mistakes.zh: 比较 `lo > hi`，比较的是地址而不是整数。

mistakes.en: Passing values instead of addresses, as in `swap_int(x, y)`.
mistakes.zh: 传值而不是传地址，例如 `swap_int(x, y)`。

title.en: Walk an array with a pointer
title.zh: 用指针遍历数组

prompt.en:
A range is given by two pointers: `begin` points to the first element and `end` points one past the last element. The range is empty when `begin == end`.

Write two functions that walk the range with a pointer. Do not use an index variable or `p[i]`.

1. `long sum_range(const int *begin, const int *end)` returns the sum of all elements, as a `long`.
2. `const int *first_over(const int *begin, const int *end, int limit)` returns a pointer to the first element that is greater than `limit`, or `end` if there is none.
prompt.zh:
用两个指针表示一个区间：`begin` 指向第一个元素，`end` 指向最后一个元素之后的位置。当 `begin == end` 时区间为空。

编写两个用指针遍历区间的函数。不要使用下标变量或 `p[i]`。

1. `long sum_range(const int *begin, const int *end)`：返回所有元素之和，类型为 `long`。
2. `const int *first_over(const int *begin, const int *end, int limit)`：返回指向第一个大于 `limit` 的元素的指针；如果没有，返回 `end`。

text.en: `sum_range` starts a pointer at `begin`, loops while `p < end`, adds `*p`, and moves with `p++` (no index variable).
text.zh: `sum_range` 让指针从 `begin` 开始，当 `p < end` 时循环，累加 `*p`，并用 `p++` 前进（没有下标变量）。

text.en: The total is a `long` starting at 0, so an empty range gives 0.
text.zh: 总和是从 0 开始的 `long`，所以空区间得到 0。

text.en: `first_over` returns a pointer into the range, not an index and not the value.
text.zh: `first_over` 返回区间内的指针，而不是下标，也不是元素的值。

text.en: `first_over` returns `end` when no element is greater than `limit`, and never reads `*end`.
text.zh: 没有元素大于 `limit` 时 `first_over` 返回 `end`，并且从不读取 `*end`。

mistakes.en: Looping `p <= end`. The element at `end` is outside the range, so reading it is undefined behaviour.
mistakes.zh: 循环条件写成 `p <= end`。`end` 处的元素不在区间内，读取它是未定义行为。

mistakes.en: Adding `p` instead of `*p`, which adds an address to a number.
mistakes.zh: 累加 `p` 而不是 `*p`，等于把地址加到数值上。

mistakes.en: In `first_over`, testing `*p > limit` before `p < end`. On the last step the read goes past the range.
mistakes.zh: 在 `first_over` 中先判断 `*p > limit` 再判断 `p < end`。最后一步会读到区间之外。

mistakes.en: Returning `*p` or `p - begin` where the question asks for a pointer.
mistakes.zh: 题目要求返回指针，却返回了 `*p` 或 `p - begin`。

title.en: Copy and join strings on the heap
title.zh: 在堆上复制并拼接字符串

prompt.en:
Write two functions that return a new heap string. The caller will free it.

1. `char *dup_text(const char *s)` returns a copy of `s`, or NULL if `malloc` fails.
2. `char *join_dash(const char *a, const char *b)` returns a new string that is `a`, then one '-', then `b`. For "ab" and "cde" the result is "ab-cde". It returns NULL if `malloc` fails.

Allocate exactly the size you need, count the terminator, and do not change `a`, `b` or `s`. You may use `strlen`, `memcpy` and `malloc`.
prompt.zh:
编写两个返回新堆字符串的函数，调用者之后会 `free` 它。

1. `char *dup_text(const char *s)`：返回 `s` 的副本；如果 `malloc` 失败，返回 NULL。
2. `char *join_dash(const char *a, const char *b)`：返回一个新字符串，内容是 `a`，然后一个 '-'，然后 `b`。例如 "ab" 和 "cde" 得到 "ab-cde"。如果 `malloc` 失败，返回 NULL。

分配恰好需要的大小，别忘了终止符，并且不要修改 `a`、`b` 或 `s`。可以使用 `strlen`、`memcpy` 和 `malloc`。

text.en: `dup_text` allocates `strlen(s) + 1` bytes: one extra byte for the terminator.
text.zh: `dup_text` 分配 `strlen(s) + 1` 字节：多一个字节放终止符。

text.en: `dup_text` checks the `malloc` result and returns NULL on failure before copying.
text.zh: `dup_text` 先检查 `malloc` 的结果，失败时返回 NULL，再进行复制。

text.en: `dup_text` copies the characters and the terminator into the new block, and returns that block (not `s`).
text.zh: `dup_text` 把字符和终止符复制到新块中，并返回新块（不是 `s`）。

text.en: `join_dash` allocates `strlen(a) + 1 + strlen(b) + 1` bytes.
text.zh: `join_dash` 分配 `strlen(a) + 1 + strlen(b) + 1` 字节。

text.en: `join_dash` puts '-' right after `a` and copies `b` after it, including b's terminator.
text.zh: `join_dash` 把 '-' 放在 `a` 之后，再复制 `b`，包括 `b` 的终止符。

text.en: `join_dash` checks the `malloc` result before writing.
text.zh: `join_dash` 在写入之前检查 `malloc` 的结果。

mistakes.en: Allocating `strlen(s)` bytes. The terminator is written one byte past the block.
mistakes.zh: 只分配 `strlen(s)` 字节。终止符会被写到块之外一个字节。

mistakes.en: Using `sizeof(s)` for the size. `s` is a pointer, so this is the size of a pointer, not the length of the text.
mistakes.zh: 用 `sizeof(s)` 作为大小。`s` 是指针，得到的是指针的大小而不是文本的长度。

mistakes.en: Returning `s` or a local array. The caller gets the original text or a dangling pointer, not a new heap string.
mistakes.zh: 返回 `s` 或局部数组。调用者拿到的是原文本或悬空指针，而不是新的堆字符串。

mistakes.en: Using the result of `malloc` without checking for NULL.
mistakes.zh: 没有检查 NULL 就使用 `malloc` 的结果。

title.en: A growable array of ints
title.zh: 可增长的 int 数组

prompt.en:
The struct below holds a growable array: `data` points to a heap block with room for `cap` ints, and `len` of them are in use.

Write three functions.

1. `void vec_init(IntVec *v)` makes an empty vector: no block, `len` and `cap` both 0.
2. `bool vec_push(IntVec *v, int x)` appends `x`. When the block is full (`len == cap`), grow it with `realloc` first: to 4 ints if `cap` is 0, otherwise to twice the old capacity. If `realloc` fails, return false and leave the vector exactly as it was. Return true on success.
3. `void vec_free(IntVec *v)` frees the block and leaves the vector empty again.

Assume `v` is not NULL and the sizes never overflow.
prompt.zh:
下面的结构体表示一个可增长的数组：`data` 指向一块能放 `cap` 个 int 的堆内存，其中 `len` 个已被使用。

编写三个函数。

1. `void vec_init(IntVec *v)`：创建空向量：没有内存块，`len` 和 `cap` 都是 0。
2. `bool vec_push(IntVec *v, int x)`：追加 `x`。当内存块已满（`len == cap`）时，先用 `realloc` 扩容：`cap` 为 0 时扩到 4 个 int，否则扩到原容量的两倍。如果 `realloc` 失败，返回 false，并且让向量保持原样。成功时返回 true。
3. `void vec_free(IntVec *v)`：释放内存块，并让向量重新回到空的状态。

假设 `v` 不是 NULL，大小计算不会溢出。

text.en: `vec_init` sets `data` to NULL and both counts to 0 (it does not allocate).
text.zh: `vec_init` 把 `data` 设为 NULL，两个计数都设为 0（不分配内存）。

text.en: `vec_push` grows the block only when `len == cap`.
text.zh: `vec_push` 只在 `len == cap` 时扩容。

text.en: New capacity is 4 when `cap` is 0, otherwise `cap * 2`; the byte count is `newcap * sizeof(int)`.
text.zh: `cap` 为 0 时新容量是 4，否则是 `cap * 2`；字节数是 `newcap * sizeof(int)`。

text.en: The `realloc` result goes into a temporary pointer and is checked for NULL, so the old block is not lost on failure.
text.zh: `realloc` 的结果先放进临时指针并检查是否为 NULL，这样失败时不会丢掉旧的内存块。

text.en: `data` and `cap` are updated only after `realloc` succeeded; failure returns false.
text.zh: 只有 `realloc` 成功之后才更新 `data` 和 `cap`；失败时返回 false。

text.en: Stores `x` at `data[len]`, increments `len`, and returns true.
text.zh: 把 `x` 存到 `data[len]`，让 `len` 加 1，并返回 true。

text.en: `vec_free` calls `free(v->data)` and resets `data`, `len` and `cap` so the vector can be reused or freed again safely.
text.zh: `vec_free` 调用 `free(v->data)`，并重置 `data`、`len` 和 `cap`，这样向量可以安全地再次使用或再次释放。

mistakes.en: Writing `v->data = realloc(v->data, ...)` directly. If it returns NULL, the old block is lost and leaks.
mistakes.zh: 直接写 `v->data = realloc(v->data, ...)`。如果返回 NULL，旧内存块就丢了，造成泄漏。

mistakes.en: Forgetting to update `v->cap`. The next push thinks the block is still too small, or too large.
mistakes.zh: 忘记更新 `v->cap`。下一次追加时会误判内存块太小或太大。

mistakes.en: Using `sizeof(v->data)` as the element size. That is the size of a pointer, not of an int.
mistakes.zh: 用 `sizeof(v->data)` 作为元素大小。那是指针的大小而不是 int 的大小。

mistakes.en: Starting the doubling from 0 (`cap * 2` is still 0), so the first push writes into a zero-byte block.
mistakes.zh: 从 0 开始翻倍（`cap * 2` 仍然是 0），第一次追加就写进了零字节的内存块。

mistakes.en: Calling `free` but leaving `data` set. A second `vec_free` then frees the same block twice.
mistakes.zh: 调用了 `free` 却没有清空 `data`。再调用一次 `vec_free` 就会重复释放同一块内存。

title.en: Structs by value and by pointer
title.zh: 按值和按指针使用结构体

prompt.en:
A `Player` has a name stored inside the struct (room for 7 characters plus the '\0') and a score:

    typedef struct { char name[8]; int score; } Player;

Write three functions.

1. `void player_init(Player *p, const char *name, int score)` copies at most 7 characters of `name` into `p->name`, always ends it with '\0', and stores the score.
2. `Player player_bumped(Player p, int bonus)` returns a copy of the player whose score is `bonus` higher. The caller's original must not change.
3. `int best_index(const Player *list, size_t n)` returns the index of the highest score. If several players tie, return the first of them. Return -1 when `n` is 0.

Do not use `strcpy` or `strncpy`.
prompt.zh:
`Player` 的名字存放在结构体内部（可放 7 个字符加 '\0'），另有一个分数：

    typedef struct { char name[8]; int score; } Player;

编写三个函数。

1. `void player_init(Player *p, const char *name, int score)`：最多把 `name` 的 7 个字符复制到 `p->name`，总是以 '\0' 结尾，并保存分数。
2. `Player player_bumped(Player p, int bonus)`：返回一个副本，其分数高 `bonus`。调用者手里的原对象不能改变。
3. `int best_index(const Player *list, size_t n)`：返回最高分的下标。如果有多人同分，返回其中第一个。当 `n` 为 0 时返回 -1。

不要使用 `strcpy` 或 `strncpy`。

text.en: `player_init` copies at most 7 characters (stops at the '\0' of `name` or when 7 are copied) and then always writes the terminator.
text.zh: `player_init` 最多复制 7 个字符（遇到 `name` 的 '\0' 或已复制 7 个就停止），然后总是写入终止符。

text.en: `player_init` stores the score through the pointer (`p->score`).
text.zh: `player_init` 通过指针（`p->score`）保存分数。

text.en: `player_bumped` changes the parameter copy (a struct passed by value) and returns it; the caller's struct is untouched.
text.zh: `player_bumped` 修改的是参数副本（按值传递的结构体）并返回它；调用者的结构体不受影响。

text.en: `best_index` returns -1 when `n == 0` before it touches `list`.
text.zh: `best_index` 在访问 `list` 之前先在 `n == 0` 时返回 -1。

text.en: `best_index` keeps the first best index: it replaces it only when a score is strictly greater, and it scans all `n` players.
text.zh: `best_index` 保留第一个最高分的下标：只有分数严格更大时才替换，并且扫描全部 `n` 个玩家。

mistakes.en: Writing `p.name` instead of `p->name` when `p` is a pointer (or the other way round).
mistakes.zh: `p` 是指针时写成 `p.name`（或者反过来）。

mistakes.en: Copying 8 characters and forgetting that the 8th byte must be the \0.
mistakes.zh: 复制了 8 个字符，忘了第 8 个字节必须是 \0。

mistakes.en: Using `>=` in `best_index`. A later tie then replaces the earlier player.
mistakes.zh: 在 `best_index` 里用 `>=`。后面的同分者会替换前面的玩家。

mistakes.en: Making `player_bumped` take `Player *` and change the object of the caller, when the question wants a changed copy.
mistakes.zh: 把 `player_bumped` 写成接收 `Player *` 并修改调用者的对象，而题目要的是修改后的副本。

mistakes.en: Assigning a string with `p->name = name`. An array cannot be assigned like that.
mistakes.zh: 用 `p->name = name` 给数组赋值。数组不能这样赋值。

title.en: Linked list: push, find, remove, free
title.zh: 链表：插入、查找、删除、释放

prompt.en:
A singly linked list of ints uses this node type. An empty list is a head pointer equal to NULL. Every node is allocated with `malloc`.

    typedef struct node { int value; struct node *next; } Node;

Write four functions.

1. `bool push_front(Node **head, int value)` adds a new node at the front. Return false (and change nothing) if `malloc` fails.
2. `Node *find(Node *head, int value)` returns the first node holding `value`, or NULL.
3. `bool remove_first(Node **head, int value)` unlinks and frees the first node holding `value` and returns true. If there is none, return false. It must work for the first node, a middle node and the last node, and for an empty list.
4. `void free_list(Node **head)` frees every node and sets `*head` to NULL.
prompt.zh:
下面的节点类型用来构成一个 int 单向链表。空链表就是头指针等于 NULL。每个节点都用 `malloc` 分配。

    typedef struct node { int value; struct node *next; } Node;

编写四个函数。

1. `bool push_front(Node **head, int value)`：在链表头部加入新节点。如果 `malloc` 失败，返回 false 并且不改变任何东西。
2. `Node *find(Node *head, int value)`：返回第一个保存 `value` 的节点，找不到返回 NULL。
3. `bool remove_first(Node **head, int value)`：断开并释放第一个保存 `value` 的节点，返回 true；没有则返回 false。它必须适用于第一个节点、中间节点、最后一个节点，以及空链表。
4. `void free_list(Node **head)`：释放所有节点，并把 `*head` 设为 NULL。

text.en: `push_front` allocates one node and returns false without touching the list if `malloc` returns NULL.
text.zh: `push_front` 分配一个节点；如果 `malloc` 返回 NULL，就返回 false 且不动链表。

text.en: `push_front` sets `n->next = *head` first and then `*head = n`, so no node is lost.
text.zh: `push_front` 先设 `n->next = *head`，再设 `*head = n`，不会丢掉任何节点。

text.en: `find` loops until NULL and compares each `value`.
text.zh: `find` 循环到 NULL，并比较每个节点的 `value`。

text.en: `find` returns the node pointer itself, or NULL when absent.
text.zh: `find` 返回节点指针本身，找不到时返回 NULL。

text.en: `remove_first` stops at the first match and never dereferences NULL (works on an empty list).
text.zh: `remove_first` 在第一个匹配处停止，并且从不解引用 NULL（空链表也可用）。

text.en: It rewires the pointer that points at the dead node: `*head` for the first node, the previous `next` otherwise. A `Node **` walk handles both with one piece of code.
text.zh: 它修改指向被删节点的那个指针：删第一个节点时是 `*head`，否则是前一个节点的 `next`。用 `Node **` 遍历，一段代码就能处理两种情况。

text.en: `remove_first` frees the removed node, after saving what it needs from it.
text.zh: `remove_first` 在保存好所需信息之后释放被删除的节点。

text.en: `remove_first` returns true only when a node was removed.
text.zh: `remove_first` 只有真正删掉了节点才返回 true。

text.en: `free_list` saves `p->next` before `free(p)`.
text.zh: `free_list` 在 `free(p)` 之前先保存 `p->next`。

text.en: `free_list` sets `*head = NULL` at the end.
text.zh: `free_list` 最后把 `*head` 设为 NULL。

mistakes.en: Freeing a node and then reading `p->next` in the loop update. The node is already gone.
mistakes.zh: 先释放节点，再在循环更新里读取 `p->next`。该节点已经不存在了。

mistakes.en: Handling only the middle case with `prev->next`. Removing the first node then fails or crashes.
mistakes.zh: 只用 `prev->next` 处理中间节点。删除第一个节点时就会失败或崩溃。

mistakes.en: Passing `Node *head` to `push_front`. The function then changes its own copy and the list of the caller stays empty.
mistakes.zh: 给 `push_front` 传 `Node *head`。函数改的是自己的副本，调用者的链表仍然为空。

mistakes.en: Unlinking a node and forgetting to `free` it, which leaks one node per removal.
mistakes.zh: 断开节点后忘了 `free`，每次删除都会泄漏一个节点。

mistakes.en: Setting `*head = n` before `n->next = *head`. The new node then points to itself.
mistakes.zh: 先设 `*head = n` 再设 `n->next = *head`。新节点会指向它自己。

title.en: Count, test and pack bits
title.zh: 统计、检测与打包位

prompt.en:
Write three functions on 32-bit unsigned values. Bit 0 is the least significant bit.

1. `int popcount32(uint32_t x)` returns how many bits of `x` are 1.
2. `bool is_pow2(uint32_t x)` is true when `x` is a power of two (1, 2, 4, 8, ...). Zero is not.
3. `uint32_t set_field(uint32_t word, unsigned lo, unsigned width, uint32_t value)` returns `word` with bits `lo` to `lo + width - 1` replaced by the low `width` bits of `value`. All other bits stay unchanged. Assume `1 <= width <= 31` and `lo + width <= 32`.

For example `set_field(0xFFFFFFFF, 4, 8, 0xA5)` is `0xFFFFFA5F`.
prompt.zh:
编写三个处理 32 位无符号数的函数。第 0 位是最低位。

1. `int popcount32(uint32_t x)`：返回 `x` 中值为 1 的位的个数。
2. `bool is_pow2(uint32_t x)`：当 `x` 是 2 的幂（1、2、4、8……）时为真。0 不是。
3. `uint32_t set_field(uint32_t word, unsigned lo, unsigned width, uint32_t value)`：返回把 `word` 的第 `lo` 位到第 `lo + width - 1` 位替换成 `value` 的低 `width` 位后的结果。其他位保持不变。假设 `1 <= width <= 31` 且 `lo + width <= 32`。

例如 `set_field(0xFFFFFFFF, 4, 8, 0xA5)` 的结果是 `0xFFFFFA5F`。

text.en: `popcount32` counts every set bit exactly once (shift-and-test loop, or the `x &= x - 1` trick) and handles 0 and `0xFFFFFFFF`.
text.zh: `popcount32` 恰好统计每个为 1 的位一次（移位检测循环，或 `x &= x - 1` 技巧），并能处理 0 和 `0xFFFFFFFF`。

text.en: `is_pow2` is false for 0 and true when exactly one bit is set (for example `x != 0 && (x & (x - 1)) == 0`).
text.zh: `is_pow2` 对 0 返回假，对恰有一位为 1 的数返回真（例如 `x != 0 && (x & (x - 1)) == 0`）。

text.en: `set_field` builds a mask of `width` ones shifted left by `lo`.
text.zh: `set_field` 构造一个由 `width` 个 1 组成并左移 `lo` 位的掩码。

text.en: `set_field` clears the old field first (`word & ~mask`) before inserting.
text.zh: `set_field` 先清除旧字段（`word & ~mask`）再插入新值。

text.en: `set_field` shifts `value` by `lo` and masks it, so extra high bits of `value` cannot spill into other fields.
text.zh: `set_field` 把 `value` 左移 `lo` 位并用掩码截取，所以 `value` 多余的高位不会溢出到其他字段。

mistakes.en: Building the mask with `1 << width` on a signed `int`. Use an unsigned constant so shifts into the top bit are defined.
mistakes.zh: 用有符号 `int` 的 `1 << width` 构造掩码。应使用无符号常量，这样移到最高位时行为才有定义。

mistakes.en: Only OR-ing the new value in. The old bits of the field stay set and the result is wrong.
mistakes.zh: 只把新值用或运算并进去。字段里原有的 1 会保留，结果就错了。

mistakes.en: Using `&&` or `||` where `&` or `|` is meant. Logical operators give 0 or 1, not a bit pattern.
mistakes.zh: 在该用 `&` 或 `|` 的地方用了 `&&` 或 `||`。逻辑运算符只给出 0 或 1，不是位模式。

mistakes.en: Treating 0 as a power of two. `0 & (0 - 1)` is 0, so the bit trick alone says yes.
mistakes.zh: 把 0 当成 2 的幂。`0 & (0 - 1)` 等于 0，只用位技巧会得出“是”。

mistakes.en: Forgetting to mask the shifted value, so high bits of `value` spill into neighbouring fields; or shifting by `lo` twice.
mistakes.zh: 没有对移位后的 `value` 做掩码，`value` 的高位会溢出到相邻字段；或者对 `lo` 移了两次。

title.en: Pointers that move through an array
title.zh: 在数组中移动的指针

prompt.en:
Two pointers move through the array `a`. After each statement, fill in how far each pointer is from the start of the array (`p - a` and `q - a`, in elements) and the int each pointer points to.

The first row (the state after the declarations) is filled in for you.
prompt.zh:
两个指针在数组 `a` 中移动。每条语句执行之后，填写每个指针与数组起点的距离（`p - a` 和 `q - a`，单位是元素个数），以及每个指针当前指向的 int 值。

第一行（声明之后的状态）已经填好。

solution.en:
Pointer arithmetic moves by whole elements, so `p += 2` adds two ints, not two bytes. Subtracting two pointers into the same array gives the distance in elements.

Step by step. Start: p is a+1, q is a+4. `p += 2` makes p = a+3. `q--` makes q = a+3 as well, so both pointers now name the same element, a[3] = 40.

`*p = *q + 1` stores 41 in a[3]. Because p and q both point at a[3], both *p and *q show 41. This is aliasing: one object seen through two pointers.

`q -= 2` moves q to a[1] = 20. `p--` moves p to a[2] = 30. `*p += *q` makes a[2] = 30 + 20 = 50, so the program prints 50.
solution.zh:
指针运算以元素为单位移动，所以 `p += 2` 是前进两个 int，而不是两个字节。两个指向同一数组的指针相减，得到的是相隔的元素个数。

逐步分析。开始时 p 是 a+1，q 是 a+4。`p += 2` 之后 p = a+3。`q--` 之后 q 也等于 a+3，所以两个指针指向同一个元素 a[3] = 40。

`*p = *q + 1` 把 41 存入 a[3]。因为 p 和 q 都指向 a[3]，所以 *p 和 *q 都变成 41。这就是别名：同一个对象可以通过两个指针访问。

`q -= 2` 让 q 指向 a[1] = 20。`p--` 让 p 指向 a[2] = 30。`*p += *q` 使 a[2] = 30 + 20 = 50，所以程序输出 50。

title.en: Increment on a pointer or on what it points to
title.zh: 递增的是指针还是它指向的值

prompt.en:
After each statement, fill in: the distance `p - a` in elements, the values of `a[1]` and `a[2]`, and "newest value", which is the value just stored in `x`, `y`, `z` or `a[2]` by that statement.

Remember the precedence: postfix `++` binds tighter than `*`, and prefix `++` and `*` group right to left. The first row is filled in.
prompt.zh:
每条语句执行之后，填写：距离 `p - a`（单位是元素）、`a[1]` 和 `a[2]` 的值，以及“新值”，即该语句刚刚存入 `x`、`y`、`z` 或 `a[2]` 的值。

注意优先级：后缀 `++` 比 `*` 结合得更紧，而前缀 `++` 与 `*` 是从右向左结合。第一行已经填好。

solution.en:
`*p++` means `*(p++)`: the value is read from where p points now, and then p moves on. So x gets a[0] = 5 and p becomes a+1.

`(*p)++` has parentheses, so it is the pointee that changes, not the pointer. y gets the old a[1] = 6, a[1] becomes 7, and p stays at a+1.

`*++p` moves p first (to a+2) and then reads: z = a[2] = 7.

Finally `*p = x + y + z` stores 5 + 6 + 7 = 18 into a[2]. The program prints "5 7 18 8".
solution.zh:
`*p++` 等价于 `*(p++)`：先从 p 当前指向的位置读值，然后 p 再前进。所以 x 得到 a[0] = 5，p 变成 a+1。

`(*p)++` 带有括号，因此改变的是被指向的值，而不是指针。y 得到旧的 a[1] = 6，a[1] 变成 7，p 仍然停在 a+1。

`*++p` 先移动 p（到 a+2），再读值：z = a[2] = 7。

最后 `*p = x + y + z` 把 5 + 6 + 7 = 18 存入 a[2]。程序输出 "5 7 18 8"。

title.en: Scan and edit a string in place
title.zh: 原地扫描并修改字符串

prompt.en:
The array `s` holds the 7 characters c, 0, d, e, -, 4, 2 followed by the terminator. The loop visits one character per row.

For each value of `i`, fill in the character `s[i]` after the loop body has run, then the values of `digits` and `letters` after that iteration. A digit is replaced by '#'. Both counters start at 0.
prompt.zh:
数组 `s` 保存 7 个字符 c、0、d、e、-、4、2，后面跟着终止符。循环每一行访问一个字符。

对每个 `i`，填写循环体执行之后的字符 `s[i]`，以及这次迭代之后 `digits` 和 `letters` 的值。数字会被替换成 '#'。两个计数器开始时都是 0。

solution.en:
The loop stops at the terminator, so it visits exactly the 7 real characters. `s` is a writable array (not a string literal), so assigning `s[i] = '#'` is allowed.

Each character falls into one branch. 'c', 'd' and 'e' are letters, so only `letters` grows. '0', '4' and '2' are digits, so `digits` grows and the character becomes '#'. The '-' is neither, so nothing changes in that row.

Final state: s is "c#de-##", digits is 3 and letters is 3. The program prints "c#de-## 3 3". The string is still 7 characters long, because only characters were replaced and the terminator was not touched.
solution.zh:
循环遇到终止符就停止，所以恰好访问 7 个真正的字符。`s` 是可写的数组（不是字符串字面量），因此 `s[i] = '#'` 是允许的。

每个字符只会进入一个分支。'c'、'd'、'e' 是字母，所以只有 `letters` 增加。'0'、'4'、'2' 是数字，所以 `digits` 增加，并且字符变成 '#'。'-' 既不是字母也不是数字，那一行什么都不变。

最终状态：s 是 "c#de-##"，digits 为 3，letters 为 3。程序输出 "c#de-## 3 3"。字符串长度仍然是 7，因为只是替换了字符，终止符没有被改动。

title.en: A recursive function on a list
title.zh: 作用于链表的递归函数

prompt.en:
The four nodes below hold 4, 9, 2 and 7 in that order, and the last node's `next` is NULL. The function `alt` calls itself on the next node.

The rows are the calls in the order they START. For each call, fill in `n->v`, the value it returns, and the order in which the call FINISHES (1 means the first call to return). The row for `alt(NULL)` is partly filled in.
prompt.zh:
下面的四个节点依次保存 4、9、2、7，最后一个节点的 `next` 是 NULL。函数 `alt` 对下一个节点递归调用自己。

各行是按调用“开始”的先后顺序排列的。对每次调用，填写 `n->v`、它的返回值，以及它“结束”的顺序（1 表示第一个返回的调用）。`alt(NULL)` 那一行已经填了一部分。

solution.en:
Each call waits for the call below it, so the calls start from the top (a) and finish from the bottom (NULL). The last call is the base case and returns 0 without recursing.

Unwinding, from the bottom: alt(NULL) = 0. alt(&d) = 7 - 0 = 7. alt(&c) = 2 - 7 = -5. alt(&b) = 9 - (-5) = 14. alt(&a) = 4 - 14 = -10.

So the program prints -10. The call that started first is the one that finishes last: the calls form a stack, and each frame keeps its own `n` until the call below it returns.
solution.zh:
每次调用都要等待它下面的那次调用，所以调用从上（a）开始，而结束则从下（NULL）开始。最后一次调用是基本情形，不再递归，直接返回 0。

从下往上展开：alt(NULL) = 0。alt(&d) = 7 - 0 = 7。alt(&c) = 2 - 7 = -5。alt(&b) = 9 - (-5) = 14。alt(&a) = 4 - 14 = -10。

所以程序输出 -10。最先开始的调用最后结束：这些调用构成一个栈，每个栈帧都保留自己的 `n`，直到它下面的调用返回。

title.en: Struct copy with a pointer member
title.zh: 带指针成员的结构体复制

prompt.en:
A `Unit` has an int `hp` and a pointer `shield` to an int. After each statement, fill in the values of `a.hp`, `b.hp` and `s`.

Remember: assigning a struct copies every member, including the pointer, but not the thing the pointer points to. The first row is filled in.
prompt.zh:
`Unit` 有一个 int 成员 `hp` 和一个指向 int 的指针 `shield`。每条语句执行之后，填写 `a.hp`、`b.hp` 和 `s` 的值。

注意：结构体赋值会复制每个成员，包括指针本身，但不会复制指针指向的对象。第一行已经填好。

solution.en:
`Unit b = a` copies hp (10) and also copies the pointer: a.shield and b.shield both point to s. After the copy, a.hp and b.hp are separate ints, so `b.hp -= 3` does not touch a.hp.

`*b.shield += 2` follows the shared pointer and changes s to 7. Because a.shield points to the same s, `a.hp += *a.shield` adds 7 to a.hp, giving 17.

`c` points at a, so `c->hp = b.hp` is the same as `a.hp = 7`.

`a.shield = &a.hp` redirects only a's pointer, so b.shield still points to s. Now `*a.shield *= 2` doubles a.hp (7 to 14), and s does not change. The program prints "14 7 7".
solution.zh:
`Unit b = a` 复制了 hp（10），同时也复制了指针：a.shield 和 b.shield 都指向 s。复制之后，a.hp 与 b.hp 是两个独立的 int，所以 `b.hp -= 3` 不影响 a.hp。

`*b.shield += 2` 沿着共享的指针修改，s 变成 7。因为 a.shield 指向同一个 s，`a.hp += *a.shield` 把 7 加到 a.hp 上，得到 17。

`c` 指向 a，所以 `c->hp = b.hp` 等价于 `a.hp = 7`。

`a.shield = &a.hp` 只改变 a 的指针，b.shield 仍然指向 s。此时 `*a.shield *= 2` 把 a.hp 翻倍（7 变 14），s 不变。程序输出 "14 7 7"。

title.en: A chain of processes
title.zh: 一条进程链

prompt.en:
Assume every `fork` succeeds and `wait` returns after the child has finished.

Name the processes: P0 is the original process, P1 is the child that P0 creates, P2 is the child that P1 creates, and so on. Every process runs the same loop and the same `printf`.

For each process, fill in how many times it calls `fork()`, which value of `i` it prints, and at which line of the combined output its line appears (1 means the first line printed). The first row is partly filled in.
prompt.zh:
假设每次 `fork` 都成功，并且 `wait` 在子进程结束之后才返回。

给进程命名：P0 是原始进程，P1 是 P0 创建的子进程，P2 是 P1 创建的子进程，依此类推。每个进程运行同一个循环和同一条 `printf`。

对每个进程，填写：它调用了多少次 `fork()`、它打印的 `i` 的值，以及它的那一行在整个输出中排第几行（1 表示第一个打印的行）。第一行已经填好一部分。

solution.en:
`fork() > 0` is true only in the parent. The parent waits for its child and then leaves the loop with the current `i`. The child gets 0, so it skips the `if` and carries on with the next iteration.

P0 forks at i = 0 and becomes the parent, so it leaves with i = 0. Its child P1 continues with i = 1, forks P2, waits and leaves with i = 1. P2 continues with i = 2, forks P3, waits and leaves with i = 2. P3 continues with i = 3, the loop condition is false, so P3 calls fork() no more and prints i = 3. That makes 4 processes.

The printing order comes from `wait`. P3 has nobody to wait for, so it prints first. P2 prints after P3 ended, P1 after P2 ended, and P0 last. The output is: i=3, i=2, i=1, i=0. Without the `wait` calls the order would not be fixed.
solution.zh:
`fork() > 0` 只在父进程中为真。父进程等待它的子进程结束，然后带着当前的 `i` 退出循环。子进程得到的返回值是 0，所以跳过 `if`，继续下一轮迭代。

P0 在 i = 0 时调用 fork 并成为父进程，因此以 i = 0 退出循环。它的子进程 P1 从 i = 1 继续，创建 P2，等待，然后以 i = 1 退出。P2 从 i = 2 继续，创建 P3，等待，然后以 i = 2 退出。P3 从 i = 3 继续，循环条件为假，所以 P3 不再调用 fork，并打印 i = 3。一共有 4 个进程。

打印顺序由 `wait` 决定。P3 没有需要等待的子进程，所以最先打印。P2 在 P3 结束之后打印，P1 在 P2 结束之后打印，P0 最后打印。输出依次是 i=3、i=2、i=1、i=0。如果没有 `wait`，顺序就不确定。

title.en: Each child works on its own copy
title.zh: 每个子进程处理自己的副本

prompt.en:
Assume every `fork` succeeds. A child finishes with `_exit(total)`, and the parent reads that value back with `WEXITSTATUS`. The parent waits for each child before the next loop iteration.

For each value of `k`, fill in: the parent's `total` just before the fork, the exit status of the child, and the parent's `total` after the `waitpid` line. The first row is partly filled in.
prompt.zh:
假设每次 `fork` 都成功。子进程用 `_exit(total)` 结束，父进程用 `WEXITSTATUS` 读回这个值。父进程在下一次循环迭代之前先等待每个子进程。

对每个 `k`，填写：fork 之前父进程的 `total`、子进程的退出状态，以及 `waitpid` 那一行之后父进程的 `total`。第一行已经填好一部分。

solution.en:
After `fork`, parent and child have separate copies of `total`. The child's `total += k * 10` changes only its own copy, and the parent never sees that change. The only thing that comes back is the exit status, which is `total` truncated to 8 bits (fine here, all values are below 256).

k = 1: the child starts from the parent's copy 0, adds 10, and exits with 10. The parent adds 10 / 10 = 1, so its total becomes 1.

k = 2: the child copies total = 1, adds 20 and exits with 21. The parent adds 21 / 10 = 2 (integer division), so total becomes 3.

k = 3: the child copies 3, adds 30 and exits with 33. The parent adds 33 / 10 = 3, so total becomes 6. The program prints 6, not 60: the children's additions were never written back into the parent.
solution.zh:
`fork` 之后，父子进程各自拥有一份独立的 `total`。子进程执行 `total += k * 10` 只改变它自己的那份，父进程看不到这个变化。唯一传回来的是退出状态，也就是 `total` 截断为 8 位后的值（这里所有的值都小于 256，所以没有问题）。

k = 1：子进程从父进程的副本 0 开始，加 10，以 10 退出。父进程加上 10 / 10 = 1，total 变成 1。

k = 2：子进程复制到的 total 是 1，加 20，以 21 退出。父进程加上 21 / 10 = 2（整数除法），total 变成 3。

k = 3：子进程复制到 3，加 30，以 33 退出。父进程加上 33 / 10 = 3，total 变成 6。程序输出 6，而不是 60：子进程的加法从未写回父进程。

title.en: A function pointer chosen at run time
title.zh: 运行时选择的函数指针

prompt.en:
`fold` applies the function it is given to an accumulator and each element in turn. In `main`, the table holds three functions and `init` holds the starting accumulator for each.

For each value of `k`, fill in the accumulator after the first element, after the second element, and the value that `main` prints. The first row is partly filled in.
prompt.zh:
`fold` 把收到的函数依次作用于累加器和每个元素。在 `main` 中，`table` 保存三个函数，`init` 保存每个函数对应的累加器初值。

对每个 `k`，填写：处理完第一个元素后的累加器、处理完第二个元素后的累加器，以及 `main` 打印的值。第一行已经填好一部分。

solution.en:
`f(acc, v[i])` calls whichever function `f` points to, so the same loop does different work for different `k`. The accumulator is always the first argument.

add, starting at 0: 0+2 = 2, then 2+3 = 5, then 5+4 = 9, then 9+5 = 14.

mul, starting at 1: 1*2 = 2, then 2*3 = 6, then 6*4 = 24, then 24*5 = 120. The start must be 1: a start of 0 would give 0 every time.

sub, starting at 0: 0-2 = -2, then -2-3 = -5, then -5-4 = -9, then -9-5 = -14. Subtraction is not commutative, so the order of the arguments (acc first) matters.
solution.zh:
`f(acc, v[i])` 调用 `f` 当前指向的函数，所以同一个循环会因 `k` 不同而做不同的工作。累加器始终是第一个参数。

add，从 0 开始：0+2 = 2，然后 2+3 = 5，然后 5+4 = 9，然后 9+5 = 14。

mul，从 1 开始：1*2 = 2，然后 2*3 = 6，然后 6*4 = 24，然后 24*5 = 120。初值必须是 1：如果从 0 开始，结果永远是 0。

sub，从 0 开始：0-2 = -2，然后 -2-3 = -5，然后 -5-4 = -9，然后 -9-5 = -14。减法不满足交换律，所以参数的顺序（累加器在前）很重要。

title.en: Locals, an array and pointers to pointers
title.zh: 局部变量、数组和指向指针的指针

prompt.en:
Draw the stack, the heap and the static data at the moment execution reaches the comment HERE. Label heap blocks H1, H2, ... in the order the allocations run, and show each pointer as the label or variable it points to.

There is no heap block and no literal that a pointer refers to, so only the stack matters. Show both frames.
prompt.zh:
画出程序执行到注释 HERE 那一刻的栈、堆和静态数据。堆块按分配实际执行的先后标为 H1、H2……，每个指针都标明它所指向的标签或变量。

这里没有堆块，也没有被指针指向的字面量，所以只需要画栈。两个栈帧都要画出来。

solution.en:
Work through main first. x is 4 and y is 9. row holds 1, 2, 3. p points to x. q points to row[1]. pp points to q, so pp is a pointer to a pointer.

The call bump(*pp, y - 6) is evaluated in main: *pp is q, so target receives the address of row[1], and y - 6 is 3, so by is 3. Inside bump, `*target += by` changes the int that target points to, which is row[1] in main's frame. So row[1] becomes 2 + 3 = 5 before the line HERE. The value of x does not change.

The pointer target is a copy of q, not a copy of the number 2. That is why the change shows up in main. The frame of bump sits after the frame of main, because it is the newest call.

Drawing convention (the same in every memory question):
- Stack: one box per active call, main first and the newest call last. Each variable is a cell with its name and its current value. An array on the stack shows one cell per element. Uninitialised cells show ?.
- A pointer cell holds what it points to: H1, H2 (heap blocks, numbered in the order the malloc/calloc calls run), &name (the address of a variable or element), or the literal's text. Draw an arrow, or write the label in the cell.
- Heap: one box per block with its label, type and size. A freed block stays in the drawing and is marked (freed).
- Static data: string literals that a pointer in the program refers to (read-only; format strings of printf are not drawn), global variables and static locals, each with its name or text.
- Show the state at the marked line only.
solution.zh:
先看 main。x 是 4，y 是 9。row 保存 1、2、3。p 指向 x，q 指向 row[1]，pp 指向 q，所以 pp 是指向指针的指针。

调用 bump(*pp, y - 6) 的实参在 main 中求值：*pp 就是 q，所以 target 收到 row[1] 的地址；y - 6 等于 3，所以 by 是 3。在 bump 里，`*target += by` 修改的是 target 所指向的 int，也就是 main 栈帧里的 row[1]。因此到达 HERE 这一行时，row[1] 已经变成 2 + 3 = 5。x 的值没有变。

指针 target 是 q 的副本，而不是数字 2 的副本，所以修改在 main 中可见。bump 的栈帧画在 main 之后，因为它是最新的调用。

绘图约定（每一道内存图题都使用同一套）：
- 栈：每个正在执行的调用画一个框，main 在最前，最新的调用在最后。每个变量是一个带名字和当前值的格子。栈上的数组每个元素一格。未初始化的格子写 ?。
- 指针格子里写它所指向的东西：H1、H2（堆块，按 malloc/calloc 实际执行的先后编号）、&名字（变量或元素的地址），或字面量的文字。可以画箭头，也可以直接在格子里写标签。
- 堆：每个块一个框，写上标签、类型和大小。已释放的块仍然留在图里，并标注（freed）。
- 静态数据：程序中有指针指向的字符串字面量（只读；printf 的格式字符串不用画）、全局变量和静态局部变量，各写上名字或文字。
- 只画标记行那一刻的状态。

text.en: Two stack boxes: main first, then bump below it.
text.zh: 两个栈帧：先是 main，其后是 bump。

text.en: main shows x = 4, y = 9 and the array cells row[0] = 1, row[1] = 5, row[2] = 3 (row[1] has already changed).
text.zh: main 中显示 x = 4、y = 9，以及数组各格 row[0] = 1、row[1] = 5、row[2] = 3（row[1] 已经改变）。

text.en: p points to x, q points to row[1], and pp points to q (a pointer to a pointer, not to row[1]).
text.zh: p 指向 x，q 指向 row[1]，pp 指向 q（是指向指针，而不是直接指向 row[1]）。

text.en: bump shows target pointing to row[1] of main (an address, not the number) and by = 3.
text.zh: bump 中 target 指向 main 的 row[1]（是地址而不是数字），by = 3。

mistakes.en: Drawing target as the number 2 or 5. It is a pointer; the number lives in main's row[1].
mistakes.zh: 把 target 画成数字 2 或 5。它是指针，数字存放在 main 的 row[1] 里。

mistakes.en: Leaving row[1] at 2. The line `*target += by` has already run when execution reaches HERE.
mistakes.zh: 把 row[1] 仍然画成 2。执行到 HERE 时，`*target += by` 已经执行过了。

mistakes.en: Drawing pp with an arrow to row[1]. pp holds the address of the variable q.
mistakes.zh: 把 pp 的箭头画到 row[1]。pp 保存的是变量 q 的地址。

mistakes.en: Writing y as 3. Only the expression y - 6 equals 3; y itself stays 9.
mistakes.zh: 把 y 写成 3。只有表达式 y - 6 等于 3，y 本身仍是 9。

title.en: Two heap arrays
title.zh: 两个堆上的数组

prompt.en: Draw the stack, the heap and the static data at the moment execution reaches the comment HERE. Label heap blocks H1, H2, ... in the order the allocations run, and show each pointer as the label or variable it points to.
prompt.zh: 画出程序执行到注释 HERE 那一刻的栈、堆和静态数据。堆块按分配实际执行的先后标为 H1、H2……，每个指针都标明它所指向的标签或变量。

solution.en:
main has three variables: n = 3, and the pointers a and b. The values live in the heap, not in main.

malloc ran first, so its block is H1: an int[3]. Only a[0] and a[1] were written, so the third cell was never given a value. malloc does not clear memory, so that cell is uninitialised and is drawn as ?. Reading it would give an unpredictable value.

calloc ran second, so its block is H2: an int[2]. calloc sets every byte to zero, so b[0] is 0. Then b[1] = a[1] + 1 = 9.

a points to H1 and b points to H2. Nothing has been freed yet at the line HERE.

Drawing convention (the same in every memory question):
- Stack: one box per active call, main first and the newest call last. Each variable is a cell with its name and its current value. An array on the stack shows one cell per element. Uninitialised cells show ?.
- A pointer cell holds what it points to: H1, H2 (heap blocks, numbered in the order the malloc/calloc calls run), &name (the address of a variable or element), or the literal's text. Draw an arrow, or write the label in the cell.
- Heap: one box per block with its label, type and size. A freed block stays in the drawing and is marked (freed).
- Static data: string literals that a pointer in the program refers to (read-only; format strings of printf are not drawn), global variables and static locals, each with its name or text.
- Show the state at the marked line only.
solution.zh:
main 中有三个变量：n = 3，以及指针 a 和 b。真正的数据在堆上，不在 main 里。

malloc 先执行，所以它的块是 H1：一个 int[3]。只写了 a[0] 和 a[1]，第三个格子从来没有被赋值。malloc 不会清零，所以那个格子是未初始化的，画成 ?。读取它得到的值不可预测。

calloc 后执行，所以它的块是 H2：一个 int[2]。calloc 会把每个字节置为 0，所以 b[0] 是 0。然后 b[1] = a[1] + 1 = 9。

a 指向 H1，b 指向 H2。在 HERE 这一行，还没有释放任何东西。

绘图约定（每一道内存图题都使用同一套）：
- 栈：每个正在执行的调用画一个框，main 在最前，最新的调用在最后。每个变量是一个带名字和当前值的格子。栈上的数组每个元素一格。未初始化的格子写 ?。
- 指针格子里写它所指向的东西：H1、H2（堆块，按 malloc/calloc 实际执行的先后编号）、&名字（变量或元素的地址），或字面量的文字。可以画箭头，也可以直接在格子里写标签。

title.en: A struct that owns text
title.zh: 拥有文本的结构体

prompt.en:
Draw the stack, the heap and the static data at the moment execution reaches the comment HERE. Label heap blocks H1, H2, ... in the order the allocations run, and show each pointer as the label or variable it points to.

Draw each member of a struct as its own cell, written as variable.member (for example leon.age). The function copy_text has already returned at HERE.
prompt.zh:
画出程序执行到注释 HERE 那一刻的栈、堆和静态数据。堆块按分配实际执行的先后标为 H1、H2……，每个指针都标明它所指向的标签或变量。

结构体的每个成员各画一个格子，写成 变量.成员（例如 leon.age）。在 HERE 时 copy_text 已经返回了。

solution.en:
The literal "Leon" is read-only text in static data. copy_text allocated the first heap block, H1, with 5 chars: L, e, o, n and the terminator, and copied the literal into it. So leon.name holds H1.

`Person twin = leon` copies every member, so twin.name is a copy of the pointer. It is the same address H1, not a new text. There is only one text block. twin.age is a separate int, which is why it can be 21 while leon.age stays 20.

The second malloc made H2, a block the size of a Person. `*boxed = twin` copies both members into it: name is H1 again and age is 21. The variable boxed holds H2.

Three pointers now lead to the same text H1. That is why the program frees leon.name once, and why freeing twin.name or boxed->name as well would be a double free.

Drawing convention (the same in every memory question):
- Stack: one box per active call, main first and the newest call last. Each variable is a cell with its name and its current value. An array on the stack shows one cell per element. Uninitialised cells show ?.
- A pointer cell holds what it points to: H1, H2 (heap blocks, numbered in the order the malloc/calloc calls run), &name (the address of a variable or element), or the literal's text. Draw an arrow, or write the label in the cell.
- Heap: one box per block with its label, type and size. A freed block stays in the drawing and is marked (freed).
- Static data: string literals that a pointer in the program refers to (read-only; format strings of printf are not drawn), global variables and static locals, each with its name or text.
- Show the state at the marked line only.

`Person twin = leon` 复制每个成员，所以 twin.name 是指针的副本，仍然是同一个地址 H1，不是新的文本。文本块只有一份。twin.age 是独立的 int，所以它可以是 21，而 leon.age 仍然是 20。

第二次 malloc 得到 H2，大小等于一个 Person。`*boxed = twin` 把两个成员都复制进去：name 还是 H1，age 是 21。变量 boxed 保存 H2。

现在有三个指针通向同一份文本 H1。所以程序只对 leon.name 释放一次；如果再释放 twin.name 或 boxed->name，就是重复释放。

title.en: A list during the third push

prompt.en:

solution.en:
The three calls allocate three nodes, numbered in call order: H1 for the value 5, H2 for 8 and H3 for 2.

The first call made H1 with next = NULL (the list was empty). The second made H2 with next = H1, and moved head to H2. So when the third call starts, main's head holds H2, and the list is H2 -> H1.

At HERE the third call has built its new node H3 with value 2 and next = H2, but `*head = n` has not run yet. So main's head still holds H2 at this moment, and the new node is only reachable from n.

push_front's parameter head is a Node **. It holds the address of main's variable head, so it points to the variable (not to a node). That is how the function can change main's head. The parameter value is 2.

Drawing convention (the same in every memory question):
- Stack: one box per active call, main first and the newest call last. Each variable is a cell with its name and its current value. An array on the stack shows one cell per element. Uninitialised cells show ?.

solution.zh:
三次调用分配三个节点，按调用顺序编号：H1 保存 5，H2 保存 8，H3 保存 2。

第一次调用创建 H1，next = NULL（当时链表为空）。第二次调用创建 H2，next = H1，并让 head 指向 H2。所以第三次调用开始时，main 的 head 保存的是 H2，链表是 H2 -> H1。

到达 HERE 时，第三次调用已经建好新节点 H3，value 为 2，next = H2，但 `*head = n` 还没有执行。所以此刻 main 的 head 仍然是 H2，新节点只能通过 n 找到。

push_front 的参数 head 是 Node **。它保存的是 main 中变量 head 的地址，所以指向的是那个变量（而不是某个节点）。函数正是借此修改 main 的 head。参数 value 是 2。

绘图约定（每一道内存图题都使用同一套）：
- 栈：每个正在执行的调用画一个框，main 在最前，最新的调用在最后。每个变量是一个带名字和当前值的格子。栈上的数组每个元素一格。未初始化的格子写 ?。

- 静态数据：程序中有指针指向的字符串字面量（只读；printf 的格式字符串不用画）、全局变量和静态局部变量，各写上名字或文字。

text.en: Two stack boxes: main (head) and push_front (head, value, n), with main first.

mistakes.zh: 把 main 的 head 画成指向 H3。赋值 `*head = n` 还在标记行的下面。

mistakes.en: Drawing push_front's head as pointing straight to H2. It points to the variable head in main.
mistakes.zh: 把 push_front 的 head 直接画成指向 H2。它指向的是 main 里的变量 head。

mistakes.en: Numbering the nodes in list order (H1 = front). The numbers follow the malloc calls, so the front node is the highest number.
mistakes.zh: 按链表顺序给节点编号（H1 在最前面）。编号应当跟随 malloc 的调用顺序，所以最前面的节点编号最大。

mistakes.zh: 把 H1 的 next 留空。第一个节点的 next 是 NULL，缺少箭头并不能表达这一点。

title.en: String literal, char array and static data
title.zh: 字符串字面量、字符数组与静态数据

prompt.en:
Draw the stack, the heap and the static data at the moment execution reaches the comment HERE. Label heap blocks H1, H2, ... in the order the allocations run, and show each pointer as the label or variable it points to.

There is no heap, but there is static data. Show the global variable, the static local and the literal there.
prompt.zh:
画出程序执行到注释 HERE 那一刻的栈、堆和静态数据。堆块按分配实际执行的先后标为 H1、H2……，每个指针都标明它所指向的标签或变量。

这里没有堆，但有静态数据。全局变量、静态局部变量和字面量都要画在静态数据区。

solution.en:
Three kinds of storage appear here.

Static data holds the global counter (3), the static local calls (0 at start, 1 after calls++) and the string literal "hey". Static variables exist for the whole run, even though calls is only visible inside main. The literal is read-only text.

`char word[] = "hey"` makes an array on the stack with 4 cells and copies the characters into it: h, e, y, and the terminator. The array is a separate object from the literal. So `w[0] = 'k'` (w points to word) changes the stack array to k, e, y, \0, and the literal still reads "hey".

`const char *lit = "hey"` makes only a pointer on the stack. It points to the literal in static data. Writing through lit would be undefined behaviour, because the literal is read-only.

The program prints: key hey 3 1.

Drawing convention (the same in every memory question):
- Stack: one box per active call, main first and the newest call last. Each variable is a cell with its name and its current value. An array on the stack shows one cell per element. Uninitialised cells show ?.
- A pointer cell holds what it points to: H1, H2 (heap blocks, numbered in the order the malloc/calloc calls run), &name (the address of a variable or element), or the literal's text. Draw an arrow, or write the label in the cell.
- Heap: one box per block with its label, type and size. A freed block stays in the drawing and is marked (freed).
- Static data: string literals that a pointer in the program refers to (read-only; format strings of printf are not drawn), global variables and static locals, each with its name or text.
- Show the state at the marked line only.
solution.zh:
这里出现三种存储。

静态数据区保存全局变量 counter（3）、静态局部变量 calls（开始为 0，执行 calls++ 之后为 1）以及字符串字面量 "hey"。静态变量在整个运行期间一直存在，尽管 calls 只在 main 里可见。字面量是只读文本。

`char word[] = "hey"` 在栈上建一个 4 格的数组，并把字符复制进去：h、e、y 和终止符。这个数组与字面量是两个不同的对象。所以 `w[0] = 'k'`（w 指向 word）把栈上的数组改成 k、e、y、\0，而字面量仍然是 "hey"。

`const char *lit = "hey"` 在栈上只有一个指针，它指向静态数据区中的字面量。通过 lit 去写会导致未定义行为，因为字面量是只读的。

程序输出：key hey 3 1。

绘图约定（每一道内存图题都使用同一套）：
- 栈：每个正在执行的调用画一个框，main 在最前，最新的调用在最后。每个变量是一个带名字和当前值的格子。栈上的数组每个元素一格。未初始化的格子写 ?。
- 指针格子里写它所指向的东西：H1、H2（堆块，按 malloc/calloc 实际执行的先后编号）、&名字（变量或元素的地址），或字面量的文字。可以画箭头，也可以直接在格子里写标签。
- 堆：每个块一个框，写上标签、类型和大小。已释放的块仍然留在图里，并标注（freed）。
- 静态数据：程序中有指针指向的字符串字面量（只读；printf 的格式字符串不用画）、全局变量和静态局部变量，各写上名字或文字。
- 只画标记行那一刻的状态。

text.en: Static data contains the read-only literal "hey".
text.zh: 静态数据区中有只读字面量 "hey"。

text.en: counter = 3 and calls = 1 are drawn in static data, not in main's frame.
text.zh: counter = 3 和 calls = 1 画在静态数据区，而不是 main 的栈帧里。

text.en: word is a stack array of 4 cells: k, e, y and the terminator (the first cell already changed).
text.zh: word 是栈上 4 个格子的数组：k、e、y 和终止符（第一个格子已被改动）。

text.en: lit points to the literal in static data and w points to word.
text.zh: lit 指向静态数据区中的字面量，w 指向 word。

mistakes.en: Writing "key" into the literal as well. The array was a copy; the literal is unchanged.
mistakes.zh: 连字面量也改成了 "key"。数组只是一个副本，字面量没有变。

mistakes.en: Drawing lit as a four-cell array. It is a single pointer; the characters are in static data.
mistakes.zh: 把 lit 画成四个格子的数组。它只是一个指针，字符在静态数据区中。

mistakes.zh: 把 calls 放进 main 的栈帧。静态局部变量保存在静态数据区，并在多次调用之间保留值。

title.en: A pointer to freed memory
title.zh: 指向已释放内存的指针

prompt.en:
Draw the stack, the heap and the static data at the moment execution reaches the comment HERE. Label heap blocks H1, H2, ... in the order the allocations run, and show each pointer as the label or variable it points to.

A block that has been freed must stay in your drawing, marked (freed).
prompt.zh:
画出程序执行到注释 HERE 那一刻的栈、堆和静态数据。堆块按分配实际执行的先后标为 H1、H2……，每个指针都标明它所指向的标签或变量。

已经释放的块必须仍然留在图里，并标注（freed）。

solution.en:
Allocation order gives the labels: the first malloc is H1 (value 41), the second is H2 (value 7). At the start q is a copy of p, so both p and q hold H1.

`free(p)` gives the block H1 back to the allocator. It does not change the pointer variables. Then `p = NULL` changes only p. The variable q still holds the old address H1, and H1 is no longer valid memory. That is a dangling pointer. It looks like a normal pointer, but reading or writing through q would be undefined behaviour, and freeing it again would be a double free.

So at HERE: p is NULL, q is H1 (dangling), r is H2. The block H1 stays in the drawing, marked (freed); its cell is drawn as ? because the old value 41 must not be relied on. The block H2 is live and still holds 7. Setting one pointer to NULL does not protect the other copies.

Drawing convention (the same in every memory question):
- Stack: one box per active call, main first and the newest call last. Each variable is a cell with its name and its current value. An array on the stack shows one cell per element. Uninitialised cells show ?.
- A pointer cell holds what it points to: H1, H2 (heap blocks, numbered in the order the malloc/calloc calls run), &name (the address of a variable or element), or the literal's text. Draw an arrow, or write the label in the cell.
- Heap: one box per block with its label, type and size. A freed block stays in the drawing and is marked (freed).
- Static data: string literals that a pointer in the program refers to (read-only; format strings of printf are not drawn), global variables and static locals, each with its name or text.
- Show the state at the marked line only.
solution.zh:
分配顺序决定标签：第一个 malloc 是 H1（值 41），第二个是 H2（值 7）。一开始 q 是 p 的副本，所以 p 和 q 都保存 H1。

`free(p)` 把块 H1 还给分配器，但不会改变指针变量。随后 `p = NULL` 只改变 p。变量 q 仍然保存旧地址 H1，而 H1 已经不是有效的内存。这就是悬空指针。它看起来和普通指针一样，但通过 q 读或写都是未定义行为，再次释放它则是重复释放。

所以在 HERE：p 是 NULL，q 是 H1（悬空），r 是 H2。块 H1 仍然留在图里，标注（freed）；它的格子画成 ?，因为不能再依赖旧值 41。块 H2 仍然有效，保存 7。把一个指针置为 NULL，并不能保护其他副本。

绘图约定（每一道内存图题都使用同一套）：
- 栈：每个正在执行的调用画一个框，main 在最前，最新的调用在最后。每个变量是一个带名字和当前值的格子。栈上的数组每个元素一格。未初始化的格子写 ?。
- 指针格子里写它所指向的东西：H1、H2（堆块，按 malloc/calloc 实际执行的先后编号）、&名字（变量或元素的地址），或字面量的文字。可以画箭头，也可以直接在格子里写标签。
- 堆：每个块一个框，写上标签、类型和大小。已释放的块仍然留在图里，并标注（freed）。
- 静态数据：程序中有指针指向的字符串字面量（只读；printf 的格式字符串不用画）、全局变量和静态局部变量，各写上名字或文字。
- 只画标记行那一刻的状态。

text.en: The stack has p = NULL, q and r in main.
text.zh: 栈中 main 里有 p = NULL、q 和 r。

text.en: q still holds H1: it was not changed by `free(p)` or by `p = NULL`.
text.zh: q 仍然保存 H1：`free(p)` 和 `p = NULL` 都没有改变它。

text.en: H1 stays in the drawing, marked (freed), with its cell shown as ? (not 41).
text.zh: H1 仍然留在图中，标注（freed），格子画成 ?（不是 41）。

text.en: q is clearly marked or described as dangling.
text.zh: 明确把 q 标注或说明为悬空指针。

text.en: H2 is a live block holding 7 and r points to it.
text.zh: H2 是仍然有效的块，保存 7，r 指向它。

mistakes.en: Erasing H1 from the drawing. The drawing must show that q still points at a block that no longer belongs to the program.
mistakes.zh: 把 H1 从图里擦掉。图里必须表现出 q 仍然指向一块已经不属于程序的内存。

mistakes.en: Setting q to NULL as well. Only p was assigned NULL.
mistakes.zh: 把 q 也画成 NULL。被赋值为 NULL 的只有 p。

mistakes.en: Leaving 41 in H1 as if it were still valid.
mistakes.zh: 把 41 留在 H1 里，好像它仍然有效。

mistakes.en: Labelling the blocks by variable name (the block of p) instead of H1, H2. The block lives on after the name is gone.
mistakes.zh: 用变量名（p 的块）而不是 H1、H2 来标记块。变量名没了，块仍然存在。

title.en: The sum of the first n values is too big
title.zh: 前 n 个数之和偏大

prompt.en:
`sum_first(a, n)` should return the sum of the first `n` elements of `a`. The caller's array is longer than `n`.

Leon tests it with the array {1, 2, 3, 4, 1000, 2000} and n = 4. The function returns 1010, but the correct answer is 10.

Find the bug, explain why the result is 1010, and write the corrected function.
prompt.zh:
`sum_first(a, n)` 应该返回数组 `a` 前 `n` 个元素之和。调用者的数组比 `n` 更长。

Leon 用数组 {1, 2, 3, 4, 1000, 2000} 和 n = 4 测试。函数返回 1010，但正确答案是 10。

找出错误，解释为什么结果是 1010，并写出修正后的函数。

solution.en:
The loop condition is `i <= n`. The first n elements have indexes 0 to n - 1, so the loop must stop before i reaches n. With `<=` it also adds a[n], one element too many.

In the test, n = 4 and a[4] is 1000, so the result is 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 1000 = 1010. With n = 0 the function still adds a[0], and with n = 1 it adds a[0] and a[1].

The fix is `i < n`. Note why the test array is longer than n: it hides how dangerous the bug is. If the array had exactly n elements, a[n] would be outside it, and reading it is undefined behaviour. This is an off-by-one error: a count n gives valid indexes 0 .. n - 1.
solution.zh:
循环条件写成了 `i <= n`。前 n 个元素的下标是 0 到 n - 1，所以循环必须在 i 到达 n 之前停止。用 `<=` 会多加一个 a[n]。

测试中 n = 4，a[4] 是 1000，所以结果是 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 1000 = 1010。当 n = 0 时，函数仍然会加上 a[0]；当 n = 1 时，会加上 a[0] 和 a[1]。

修正方法是改成 `i < n`。注意测试数组比 n 长，这掩盖了这个错误的危险性。如果数组恰好只有 n 个元素，a[n] 就在数组之外，读取它是未定义行为。这是典型的差一错误：n 个元素对应的有效下标是 0 .. n - 1。

text.en: Names the loop condition `i <= n` as the bug: it visits index n, one element too many.
text.zh: 指出循环条件 `i <= n` 是错误所在：它会访问下标 n，多了一个元素。

text.en: Explains the 1010: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 plus a[4] = 1000.
Gives a corrected loop `i < n` (or an equivalent pointer loop up to `a + n`).
text.zh: 给出修正后的循环 `i < n`（或等价的指针循环，终点为 `a + n`）。

text.en: Notes that with an array of exactly n elements the old code reads out of bounds, which is undefined behaviour.
text.zh: 指出如果数组恰好只有 n 个元素，原代码会越界读取，这是未定义行为。

mistakes.en: Changing the start to `i = 1`. That skips a[0] and still reads a[n].
mistakes.zh: 把起点改成 `i = 1`。这样会漏掉 a[0]，仍然会读到 a[n]。

mistakes.en: Using `i < n - 1`. This drops the last wanted element, and wraps around when n is 0 with an unsigned type.
mistakes.zh: 改成 `i < n - 1`。这样会丢掉最后一个需要的元素，并且 n 为 0 时无符号数会回绕。

mistakes.en: Blaming the caller for passing an array longer than n. The function is meant to handle that.
mistakes.zh: 怪调用者传了比 n 长的数组。函数本来就应该能处理这种情况。

title.en: Names are cut after 7 characters
title.zh: 名字在第 7 个字符后被截断

prompt.en:
Every field that holds a name is an array of `NAME_CAP` (16) bytes. `copy_name` should copy up to 15 characters of `src` and always end the field with '\0'.

Mia tests it with "Iris-Leon-Mia-Jack-Noah". The result has only 7 characters (on a machine where a pointer is 8 bytes), but 15 are expected. Short names look fine.

Find the bug, explain it, and write the corrected function.
prompt.zh:
每个保存名字的字段都是 `NAME_CAP`（16）字节的数组。`copy_name` 应该最多复制 `src` 的 15 个字符，并且总是以 '\0' 结尾。

Mia 用 "Iris-Leon-Mia-Jack-Noah" 测试。结果只有 7 个字符（在指针为 8 字节的机器上），但期望是 15 个。短名字看起来没有问题。

找出错误，解释原因，并写出修正后的函数。

solution.en:
Inside `copy_name`, dst is a `char *`. Whatever array the caller passed, the parameter is only a pointer, so `sizeof(dst)` is the size of a pointer: 8 bytes on a typical 64-bit machine (4 on a 32-bit one), not 16. The bound `sizeof(dst) - 1` is therefore 7, and the copy stops after 7 characters.

Names shorter than 7 characters never reach the bound, which is why short names looked fine. The program is wrong on any machine, but the amount depends on the pointer size.

An array loses its size information when it is passed to a function. The function must be told the size: use the constant NAME_CAP (as in the fix), or add a size parameter. `sizeof` gives the array size only where the array itself is visible.
solution.zh:
在 `copy_name` 里，dst 是 `char *`。不管调用者传入的是什么数组，参数本身只是一个指针，所以 `sizeof(dst)` 是指针的大小：典型的 64 位机器上是 8 字节（32 位机器上是 4），而不是 16。因此边界 `sizeof(dst) - 1` 是 7，复制在 7 个字符之后就停止了。

短于 7 个字符的名字不会碰到这个边界，所以短名字看起来没有问题。这个程序在任何机器上都是错的，只是错的程度取决于指针的大小。

数组传给函数时会丢失大小信息。必须另外告诉函数大小：像修正版那样使用常量 NAME_CAP，或者增加一个大小参数。`sizeof` 只有在能直接看到数组本身的地方才能给出数组的大小。

text.en: Identifies `sizeof(dst)` as the size of a pointer (not of the 16-byte field).
text.zh: 指出 `sizeof(dst)` 是指针的大小，而不是 16 字节字段的大小。

text.en: Explains that an array parameter is a pointer inside the function, so its size is lost.
text.zh: 解释数组参数在函数内部就是指针，所以大小信息丢失。

text.en: Corrects the bound to `NAME_CAP - 1` (or passes the size as a parameter).
text.zh: 把边界改正为 `NAME_CAP - 1`（或者把大小作为参数传入）。

text.en: Explains why short names hid the bug.
text.zh: 解释为什么短名字掩盖了这个错误。

mistakes.en: Replacing `sizeof(dst)` with `strlen(dst)`. dst has no terminator yet, so the length is unpredictable.
mistakes.zh: 把 `sizeof(dst)` 换成 `strlen(dst)`。dst 还没有终止符，长度不可预测。

mistakes.en: Writing `sizeof(*dst)`. That is the size of one char, which is 1.
mistakes.zh: 写成 `sizeof(*dst)`。那是一个 char 的大小，即 1。

mistakes.en: Hard-coding the guess 16 inside the loop instead of using the named constant, so the two can drift apart.
mistakes.zh: 在循环里直接写死 16，而不用命名常量，这样两处数字以后可能不一致。

mistakes.en: Forgetting the `- 1` after the fix, which leaves no room for the terminator.
mistakes.zh: 修正后忘了 `- 1`，没有给终止符留位置。

title.en: Every push is refused
title.zh: 每次 push 都被拒绝

prompt.en:
A stack holds up to 4 ints. After `stack_push` is called four times on an empty stack, every call has returned false, and `s.len` reads 4.

Find the bug, explain how it produces this behaviour, and write the corrected code. Say also what small change to the parameter type would have made the compiler reject the typo.
prompt.zh:
一个栈最多保存 4 个 int。对一个空栈调用四次 `stack_push` 之后，每次都返回了 false，而且 `s.len` 的值是 4。

找出错误，解释它为什么会造成这种现象，并写出修正后的代码。同时说明：把参数类型做怎样的小改动，编译器就会拒绝这个笔误。

solution.en:
In `stack_full`, the expression `s->len = STACK_MAX` is an assignment, not a comparison. It stores 4 into s->len, and the value of an assignment is the value stored, so the value of the expression is 4. Converting it to the bool return type gives true.

So every call of `stack_push` first calls `stack_full`, which sets len to 4 and answers "full". The push is refused, and len is left at 4 by the side effect of the check. That matches both symptoms.

The fix is `==`. A function that only asks a question should not be able to change anything, so declare the parameter `const Stack *`: with that, writing `s->len = ...` is a compile error ("cannot assign ... const"), and the typo cannot reach a test.
solution.zh:
在 `stack_full` 中，表达式 `s->len = STACK_MAX` 是赋值而不是比较。它把 4 存入 s->len，而赋值表达式的值就是被存入的值，所以这个表达式的值是 4。把它转换成返回类型 bool，结果为真。

因此每次调用 `stack_push` 都会先调用 `stack_full`，后者把 len 设为 4 并回答“已满”。push 被拒绝，而 len 因为检查函数的副作用停在了 4。这正好解释了两个现象。

修正方法是使用 `==`。只用来提问的函数不应该能改变任何东西，所以把参数声明为 `const Stack *`：这样写 `s->len = ...` 会产生编译错误（“cannot assign ... const”），笔误就不会漏到测试阶段。

text.en: Finds `=` in `stack_full` where `==` was meant.
text.zh: 找出 `stack_full` 中该写 `==` 的地方写成了 `=`。

text.en: Explains both effects: it overwrites `len` with 4, and the assignment's value (4) is true, so the function says full.
text.zh: 解释两个效果：它把 `len` 覆盖成 4，并且赋值表达式的值（4）为真，所以函数回答“已满”。

text.en: Writes the corrected comparison `s->len == STACK_MAX`.
text.zh: 写出修正后的比较 `s->len == STACK_MAX`。

text.en: Suggests `const Stack *` so the compiler rejects writes through the pointer.
text.zh: 提出使用 `const Stack *`，让编译器拒绝通过该指针写入。

mistakes.en: Fixing `stack_push` instead, for example testing `s->len < STACK_MAX` there. The bad helper stays and can break other code.
mistakes.zh: 去改 `stack_push`，例如在那里改成判断 `s->len < STACK_MAX`。有问题的辅助函数还在，会破坏其他代码。

mistakes.en: Assuming the compiler would have warned. A bare assignment after `return` compiles without any warning here; only `const` on the parameter (or a test) catches it.
mistakes.zh: 以为编译器一定会给出警告。这里 `return` 后面直接写赋值，编译时没有任何警告；只有给参数加 `const`（或者做测试）才能发现它。

mistakes.en: Thinking that the function returns 0 or 1 only from a comparison. In C an assignment also has a value.
mistakes.zh: 以为只有比较才会得到 0 或 1。在 C 中赋值表达式同样有值。

title.en: Addition behaves like subtraction
title.zh: 加法表现得像减法

prompt.en:
`apply(op, a, b)` should compute `a + b` for '+', `a - b` for '-', `a * b` for '*', and 0 for any other character.

Jack calls `apply('+', 7, 2)` and gets 5 instead of 9. The other operators work.

Find the bug, explain it, and write the corrected function.
prompt.zh:
`apply(op, a, b)` 应该在 op 为 '+' 时计算 `a + b`，为 '-' 时计算 `a - b`，为 '*' 时计算 `a * b`，其他字符返回 0。

Jack 调用 `apply('+', 7, 2)`，得到的是 5 而不是 9。其他运算符都正常。

找出错误，解释原因，并写出修正后的函数。

solution.en:
A `case` label is only an entry point. After the statements of the matching case, execution carries on into the next case unless a `break` (or return) stops it. This is called fall-through.

For '+', the code computes r = 9, but there is no `break`, so it falls into the '-' case and computes r = 7 - 2 = 5. The second assignment overwrites the first, and the function returns 5.

The other cases are fine because each ends with `break`. The fix is to add `break;` after `r = a + b;`. Fall-through is sometimes wanted (for example to share one body between two labels), but then it should be marked with a comment. Compilers can warn about it with a flag such as -Wimplicit-fallthrough.
solution.zh:
`case` 标签只是一个入口。匹配的 case 中的语句执行完之后，如果没有 `break`（或 return）阻止，程序会继续执行下一个 case。这叫做贯穿（fall-through）。

对于 '+'，代码先算出 r = 9，但没有 `break`，于是继续进入 '-' 这一支，算出 r = 7 - 2 = 5。第二次赋值覆盖了第一次，函数返回 5。

其他分支没有问题，因为每个都以 `break` 结束。修正方法是在 `r = a + b;` 之后加上 `break;`。有时确实需要贯穿（例如两个标签共用一段代码），但那时应当用注释标明。编译器可以用 -Wimplicit-fallthrough 这类选项对此发出警告。

text.en: Finds the missing `break` after the '+' case.
text.zh: 指出 '+' 分支之后缺少 `break`。

text.en: Explains fall-through: execution continues into the '-' case and its assignment overwrites r.
text.zh: 解释贯穿：程序继续进入 '-' 分支，其赋值覆盖了 r。

text.en: Gives the corrected function with `break;` added.
text.zh: 给出加上 `break;` 的修正函数。

text.en: Explains why only '+' is wrong: the other cases end with break.
text.zh: 解释为什么只有 '+' 出错：其他分支都以 break 结束。

mistakes.en: Reordering the cases so that '+' comes last. That moves the problem instead of fixing it.
mistakes.zh: 调整分支顺序，把 '+' 放到最后。这只是把问题移走，并没有解决。

mistakes.en: Replacing the switch by `if (op = '+')`, which assigns instead of comparing.
mistakes.zh: 改成 `if (op = '+')`，那是赋值而不是比较。

mistakes.en: Adding `return r;` inside the '-' case only. The '+' case still falls into it.
mistakes.zh: 只在 '-' 分支里加 `return r;`。'+' 分支仍然会落进去。

title.en: A queue that loses its middle
title.zh: 丢掉中间元素的队列

prompt.en:
A queue keeps a pointer to the first node (`head`) and the last node (`tail`) so that `enqueue` takes constant time. The queue is empty when both are NULL.

Noah enqueues 1, 2 and 3 and then prints the queue. It shows [1 3] instead of [1 2 3].

Find the bug, explain what goes wrong with the nodes, and write the corrected `enqueue`.
prompt.zh:
队列保存指向第一个节点的指针（`head`）和指向最后一个节点的指针（`tail`），这样 `enqueue` 只需常数时间。当两者都是 NULL 时队列为空。

Noah 依次入队 1、2、3，然后打印队列，显示的是 [1 3] 而不是 [1 2 3]。

找出错误，解释节点出了什么问题，并写出修正后的 `enqueue`。

solution.en:
The tail pointer must always name the last node. `enqueue` links the new node after the old last node, but only sets `q->tail = n` when the queue was empty. In the else branch the tail is not moved.

Trace it. After enqueue(1): head = tail = node 1. enqueue(2) sets node1->next = node 2, but tail still points to node 1. enqueue(3) then does tail->next = node 3, which overwrites node1->next. The list is now 1 -> 3, and node 2 is unreachable. It was never freed, so it is also leaked.

The fix is to move `q->tail = n;` out of the if, so that it runs in both cases. The invariant is: the queue is empty exactly when head and tail are both NULL, and otherwise tail is the last node. `dequeue` keeps this invariant by resetting the tail when the last node is removed.
solution.zh:
tail 指针必须始终指向最后一个节点。`enqueue` 把新节点接在原来的最后一个节点之后，但只有在队列为空时才设置 `q->tail = n`。在 else 分支里没有移动 tail。

来跟踪一下。enqueue(1) 之后：head = tail = 节点 1。enqueue(2) 设置 node1->next = 节点 2，但 tail 仍然指向节点 1。enqueue(3) 接着执行 tail->next = 节点 3，覆盖了 node1->next。链表变成 1 -> 3，节点 2 无法再被访问到。它从未被释放，因此还造成了内存泄漏。

修正方法是把 `q->tail = n;` 从 if 里面移出来，让两种情况都执行。不变式是：队列为空当且仅当 head 和 tail 都是 NULL，否则 tail 就是最后一个节点。`dequeue` 在取走最后一个节点时重置 tail，从而维持这个不变式。

text.en: Finds that `q->tail` is not updated in the non-empty branch of `enqueue`.
text.zh: 指出 `enqueue` 的非空分支中没有更新 `q->tail`。

text.en: Explains the effect: tail stays on node 1, so later nodes overwrite its next link and node 2 is lost (and leaked).
text.zh: 解释后果：tail 一直停在节点 1，后面的节点覆盖它的 next，节点 2 丢失（并泄漏）。

text.en: Corrects the code so `q->tail = n` runs in both cases.
text.zh: 修正代码，让 `q->tail = n` 在两种情况下都执行。

text.en: States the invariant: head and tail are both NULL exactly when the queue is empty, otherwise tail is the last node.
text.zh: 说明不变式：队列为空当且仅当 head 和 tail 都是 NULL，否则 tail 是最后一个节点。

mistakes.en: Walking the whole list from head on every enqueue to find the real last node. It works but costs O(n) and hides the missing update.
mistakes.zh: 每次 enqueue 都从 head 遍历整个链表找真正的最后节点。这样能工作，但需要 O(n)，并且掩盖了缺少的更新。

mistakes.en: Moving `q->head = n` out of the if as well. That breaks every enqueue after the first.
mistakes.zh: 把 `q->head = n` 也移到 if 外面。这样第一次之后的每次 enqueue 都会出错。

mistakes.en: Fixing `dequeue` instead. It already resets the tail correctly.
mistakes.zh: 去修改 `dequeue`。它已经正确地重置了 tail。

title.en: The last letter disappears
title.zh: 最后一个字母不见了

prompt.en:
`chomp(line)` should remove one trailing newline character from `line`, if the string ends with one. Strings without a trailing newline must stay unchanged, and the empty string must be safe.

Emma calls `chomp` on "abc\n" and gets "abc". On "abc" (no newline) she gets "ab".

Find the bug, explain it (also for the empty string), and write the corrected function.
prompt.zh:
`chomp(line)` 应该在字符串以换行符结尾时，删除一个结尾的换行符。没有结尾换行符的字符串必须保持不变，空字符串也必须安全。

Emma 对 "abc\n" 调用 `chomp`，得到 "abc"。对 "abc"（没有换行符）调用，得到的却是 "ab"。

找出错误，解释原因（包括空字符串的情况），并写出修正后的函数。

solution.en:
The function overwrites the last character with '\0' without looking at what it is. For "abc\n" that last character is the newline, so the result is right. For "abc" the last character is 'c', and it is destroyed, giving "ab". Text that arrives without a final newline is common: a last line in a file, or a line that fgets cut because the buffer was full.

For the empty string, strlen(line) is 0 and `strlen(line) - 1` is computed in the unsigned type size_t, so it wraps to a huge number. The write then goes far outside the array, which is undefined behaviour.

The fix tests first: only when the length is greater than 0 and the last character really is '\n' is the terminator moved one place left. Otherwise nothing changes. The rule is: never assume the last character is a newline, and never subtract from an unsigned length without checking it is not zero.
solution.zh:
这个函数不检查最后一个字符是什么，就直接把它改写成 '\0'。对 "abc\n" 来说最后一个字符正是换行符，所以结果正确。对 "abc" 来说最后一个字符是 'c'，它被破坏了，得到 "ab"。没有结尾换行符的文本很常见：文件的最后一行，或者缓冲区已满、被 fgets 截断的一行。

对于空字符串，strlen(line) 是 0，而 `strlen(line) - 1` 是用无符号类型 size_t 计算的，会回绕成一个巨大的数。这次写入会落到数组之外很远的地方，是未定义行为。

修正方法是先检查：只有长度大于 0 并且最后一个字符确实是 '\n' 时，才把终止符左移一位，否则什么都不改。规则是：永远不要假定最后一个字符是换行符，也不要在不确定长度非零的情况下对无符号长度做减法。

text.en: Finds that the last character is overwritten without checking that it is a newline.
text.zh: 指出最后一个字符被直接覆盖，没有检查它是不是换行符。

text.en: Explains the "ab" result: the letter c is destroyed.
text.zh: 解释 "ab" 的来源：字母 c 被破坏了。

text.en: Explains the empty string: `strlen - 1` wraps around in unsigned arithmetic and the write is out of bounds.
text.zh: 解释空字符串的情况：`strlen - 1` 在无符号运算中回绕，写入越界。

text.en: Gives a correct fix: checks `n > 0` and `line[n - 1] == '\n'` before writing the terminator.
text.zh: 给出正确的修正：在写入终止符之前检查 `n > 0` 和 `line[n - 1] == '\n'`。

mistakes.en: Using `line[strlen(line)] = '\0'`. That writes the terminator where it already is and removes nothing.
mistakes.zh: 用 `line[strlen(line)] = '\0'`。这只是在终止符原来的位置再写一次，什么也没删。

mistakes.en: Checking `line[n - 1] == '\n'` before checking `n > 0`. For the empty string this still reads before the array.
mistakes.zh: 先检查 `line[n - 1] == '\n'` 再检查 `n > 0`。对空字符串，这仍然会读到数组之前。

mistakes.en: Looking for a newline with `strchr` and ignoring where it is. A newline in the middle must not be removed.
mistakes.zh: 用 `strchr` 找换行符却不管它的位置。中间的换行符不应该被删除。

title.en: Two forks in a row
title.zh: 连续两次 fork

prompt.en: Assume every `fork` succeeds. Each process prints one line when it reaches the `printf`. Ignore the order of the lines. Which lines are printed?
prompt.zh: 假设每次 `fork` 都成功。每个进程执行到 `printf` 时打印一行。不考虑各行的先后顺序。会打印出哪些行？

text.en: Four lines: 0, 1, 2 and 3.

why.en: The first fork makes 2 processes. Each of them runs the second fork, so there are 4 processes. n starts at 0. The child of the first fork has n = 1. The children of the second fork add 2. The four values are 0, 1, 2 and 3.
why.zh: 第一次 fork 之后有 2 个进程。每个进程都会执行第二次 fork，所以一共有 4 个进程。n 开始是 0。第一次 fork 的子进程 n = 1。第二次 fork 的子进程再加 2。四个值是 0、1、2、3。

text.en: Three lines: 0, 1 and 2.

why.en: This counts one new process per fork call. But the child of the first fork also executes the second fork, so the count doubles each time.
why.zh: 这是按“每次 fork 调用增加一个进程”来数的。但第一次 fork 的子进程也会执行第二次 fork，所以进程数每次翻倍。

text.en: Four lines, all showing 0.
text.zh: 四行，全部显示 0。

why.en: Each process has its own copy of n, but each copy is changed inside that process. A child that runs `n = 1` or `n += 2` prints its own changed value.
why.zh: 每个进程都有自己的 n，但每个副本是在该进程内部被修改的。执行了 `n = 1` 或 `n += 2` 的子进程打印的是它自己修改后的值。

text.en: Two lines: 0 and 3.
text.zh: 两行：0 和 3。

why.en: This keeps only the first and the last process. Every process that exists at the `printf` prints a line, including the two in the middle.
why.zh: 这只保留了第一个和最后一个进程。到达 `printf` 的每个进程都会打印一行，中间的两个也不例外。

solution.en: Draw the process tree. The original process P gets a positive pid from the first fork and keeps n = 0. Its first child C1 gets 0 from the first fork and sets n = 1. Then both of them run the second fork. The new child of P gets 0 from it, so n = 0 + 2 = 2. The new child of C1 has n = 1 + 2 = 3. P and C1 themselves keep 0 and 1. That is four processes with the values 0, 1, 2 and 3.
solution.zh: 画出进程树。原始进程 P 在第一次 fork 中得到一个正的 pid，n 保持 0。它的第一个子进程 C1 在第一次 fork 中得到 0，并设 n = 1。然后这两个进程都执行第二次 fork。P 的新子进程在第二次 fork 中得到 0，所以 n = 0 + 2 = 2。C1 的新子进程 n = 1 + 2 = 3。P 和 C1 自己分别保持 0 和 1。一共四个进程，值为 0、1、2、3。

title.en: One wait for three children
title.zh: 三个子进程只调用一次 wait

prompt.en:
A parent creates three children with `fork`. Each child calls `_exit` straight away. After the loop the parent calls `wait(&st)` once, then does other work for a long time. All three children have already exited when `wait` is called.

Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh:
父进程用 `fork` 创建三个子进程，每个子进程立刻调用 `_exit`。循环之后父进程只调用一次 `wait(&st)`，然后继续做很长时间的其他工作。调用 `wait` 时三个子进程都已经退出。

下面哪个说法正确？

text.en: `wait` returns one child's status. The other two stay as zombies until the parent waits for them again (or exits).
text.zh: `wait` 只返回一个子进程的状态。另外两个会一直保持僵尸状态，直到父进程再次等待它们（或者父进程退出）。

why.en: Each call to `wait` collects one terminated child. A terminated child that nobody has waited for keeps its process-table entry as a zombie. To reap all three, call `wait` three times, or loop until it returns -1.
why.zh: 每调用一次 `wait` 只回收一个已终止的子进程。没有人等待的已终止子进程会保留进程表项，成为僵尸。要回收三个，就调用三次 `wait`，或者循环到它返回 -1。

text.en: `wait` collects all three children at once.
text.zh: `wait` 一次回收所有三个子进程。

why.en: `wait` is not a bulk operation. It returns the pid of one child per call.
why.zh: `wait` 不是批量操作，每次调用只返回一个子进程的 pid。

text.en: The other two children are killed when `wait` returns.
text.zh: `wait` 返回时，另外两个子进程会被杀死。

why.en: They have already exited, and `wait` never kills anything. Their entries simply stay until someone collects them.
why.zh: 它们本来就已经退出了，而且 `wait` 从不杀死任何进程。它们的表项只是留在那里，直到有人回收。

text.en: `wait` blocks until the parent itself is finished.
text.zh: `wait` 会一直阻塞，直到父进程自己结束。

why.en: `wait` blocks only until a child has terminated. Here children have already terminated, so it returns at once.
why.zh: `wait` 只会阻塞到有子进程终止为止。这里子进程早已终止，所以它立即返回。

solution.en: A zombie is a process that has finished, whose parent has not yet read its exit status. It uses no CPU or memory except the process-table entry, but it holds a pid. A long-running parent that forks many children and forgets to wait slowly fills the table.
solution.zh: 僵尸进程是指已经结束、但父进程还没有读取其退出状态的进程。它除了进程表项之外不占用 CPU 和内存，但仍然占着一个 pid。如果一个长期运行的父进程创建了很多子进程却不等待它们，进程表会被慢慢占满。

title.en: What follows a successful exec
title.zh: exec 成功之后会发生什么

prompt.en: Assume `/bin/echo` exists and can run, and `execl` succeeds. What does this program write to standard output?
prompt.zh: 假设 `/bin/echo` 存在并且可以运行，`execl` 调用成功。这个程序向标准输出写出什么？

text.en: A, then B
text.zh: A，然后 B

why.en: A is written and flushed first. Then `execl` replaces the program by echo, which writes B. The new program never returns to the old code, so C is never reached.
why.zh: 先写出并刷新 A。然后 `execl` 用 echo 取代当前程序，echo 写出 B。新程序不会回到旧代码，所以 C 永远执行不到。

text.en: A, then B, then C
text.zh: A，然后 B，然后 C

why.en: This treats execl as an ordinary function call. When it succeeds, it does not return; the old program image is gone.
why.zh: 这是把 execl 当成了普通函数调用。成功时它不会返回，旧的程序映像已经没有了。

text.en: A, then C
text.zh: A，然后 C

why.en: That is what happens only if execl fails and returns -1. Here it succeeds.
why.zh: 只有当 execl 失败并返回 -1 时才是这样。这里它成功了。

text.en: Only B
text.zh: 只有 B

why.en: The A was flushed before the exec, so it has already left the program. Only unflushed data in the old buffers would be lost.
why.zh: 在 exec 之前已经刷新了 A，它已经离开了程序。只有旧缓冲区里尚未刷新的数据才会丢失。

solution.en: exec does not create a process. It replaces the code, data and stack of the calling process with a new program, keeping the pid and the open file descriptors (except those marked close-on-exec). On success there is nothing to return to. Code after exec runs only when exec failed, so it usually reports the error and exits.
solution.zh: exec 并不创建新进程。它用新程序替换调用进程的代码、数据和栈，同时保留 pid 和已打开的文件描述符（标记了 close-on-exec 的除外）。成功时没有任何地方可以返回。exec 之后的代码只有在 exec 失败时才会运行，所以通常用来报告错误并退出。

title.en: A reader that never sees end of file
title.zh: 永远等不到文件结束的读者

prompt.en:
The parent creates a pipe, then forks. The child closes `fd[1]` and reads from `fd[0]` in a loop until `read` returns 0. The parent writes "hi", and then calls `wait(NULL)` for the child. The parent never closes `fd[1]`.

What happens?
prompt.zh:
父进程创建一个管道，然后 fork。子进程关闭 `fd[1]`，循环从 `fd[0]` 读取，直到 `read` 返回 0。父进程写入 "hi"，然后调用 `wait(NULL)` 等待子进程。父进程从未关闭 `fd[1]`。

会发生什么？

text.en: The program hangs: the child waits for end of file, the parent waits for the child.
text.zh: 程序卡住：子进程等待文件结束，父进程等待子进程。

why.en: End of file on a pipe appears only when every write end is closed. The parent still holds one, so after "hi" the child's read blocks for ever, and the parent's wait blocks for the child.
why.zh: 管道的文件结束只有在所有写端都关闭后才会出现。父进程仍然持有一个写端，所以读完 "hi" 之后，子进程的 read 会永远阻塞，父进程的 wait 又在等子进程。

text.en: The child reads "hi", then `read` returns 0 because the parent has written everything.
text.zh: 子进程读到 "hi" 之后 `read` 返回 0，因为父进程已经写完了。

why.en: A pipe does not know that the writer has finished writing. It only knows whether write ends are still open.
why.zh: 管道并不知道写入方是否已经写完。它只知道是否还有写端处于打开状态。

text.en: `read` returns -1 with the error EPIPE.
text.zh: `read` 返回 -1，错误码是 EPIPE。

why.en: EPIPE is reported to a writer when no read end is open. A reader sees 0 at end of file, or blocks.
why.zh: EPIPE 是在没有读端时报告给写入方的。读者在文件结束时看到的是 0，否则就阻塞。

text.en: The parent is killed by SIGPIPE when it calls `wait`.
text.zh: 父进程调用 `wait` 时被 SIGPIPE 杀死。

why.en: SIGPIPE is sent when a process writes to a pipe with no reader. Calling `wait` writes nothing, and the child holds a read end anyway.
why.zh: SIGPIPE 是在向没有读者的管道写入时发出的。调用 `wait` 并不写入任何东西，而且子进程还持有读端。

solution.en: Rule: after fork, each process closes the pipe ends it does not use. Here the parent should call `close(fd[1])` after writing, so the last write end disappears and the child's read returns 0.
solution.zh: 规则：fork 之后，每个进程都要关闭自己不用的管道端。这里父进程应当在写完之后调用 `close(fd[1])`，这样最后一个写端就消失了，子进程的 read 才会返回 0。

title.en: Three signals while blocked
title.zh: 阻塞期间收到三个信号

prompt.en:
A process installs a handler for SIGUSR1 that adds 1 to `hits`. It blocks SIGUSR1 with `sigprocmask`, then the signal is sent to the process three times (here with `raise`). Finally it unblocks SIGUSR1 and prints `hits`.

What is printed?
prompt.zh:
进程为 SIGUSR1 安装了一个处理函数，处理函数让 `hits` 加 1。进程先用 `sigprocmask` 阻塞 SIGUSR1，然后这个信号被发送给该进程三次（这里用 `raise`）。最后进程解除对 SIGUSR1 的阻塞，并打印 `hits`。

打印的是什么？

why.en: A blocked standard signal is only marked as pending. Pending is a set, not a counter, so three sends leave one mark. After unblocking, the handler runs once. (POSIX leaves repeated delivery of a blocked standard signal implementation-defined; Linux and macOS deliver it once.)
why.zh: 被阻塞的标准信号只是被标记为未决。未决信号集是一个集合而不是计数器，三次发送只留下一个标记。解除阻塞后，处理函数只运行一次。（POSIX 对被阻塞的标准信号重复发送是否多次递送没有规定，由实现决定；Linux 和 macOS 只递送一次。）

why.en: This assumes that signals queue up like messages. Standard signals do not; real-time signals can.
why.zh: 这是假定信号像消息一样排队。标准信号不会排队，实时信号才可以。

why.en: Signals that arrive while blocked are not discarded. They stay pending and are delivered when the signal is unblocked.
why.zh: 阻塞期间到达的信号不会被丢弃。它们保持未决，解除阻塞后会被递送。

text.en: The result is undefined: handlers may not be called after being blocked.
text.zh: 结果未定义：被阻塞过的信号不能再调用处理函数。
