why.en: Blocking and unblocking is the standard way to defer a handler safely. Nothing is undefined here.
why.zh: 阻塞再解除阻塞正是安全推迟处理函数的标准方法。这里没有任何未定义行为。

solution.en: Use this to remember: a signal is a flag, not a message. If you need to count events, the handler can only record that something happened, and the main code must then look at the real state (for example, wait for children in a loop). Blocking signals around a critical section is how you stop a handler from running at a bad moment.
solution.zh: 记住：信号是一个标志，而不是一条消息。如果需要统计事件次数，处理函数只能记录“发生了某件事”，主流程再去检查真实状态（例如在循环里等待子进程）。在临界区周围阻塞信号，可以避免处理函数在不合适的时刻运行。

title.en: Why a while loop around the wait
title.zh: 为什么 wait 外面要用 while 循环

prompt.en:
Several consumer threads run this code to take one item from a shared counter `count`. Producers increase `count` under the same mutex and call `pthread_cond_signal`.

Why is the wait inside `while (count == 0)` and not inside `if (count == 0)`?
prompt.zh:
多个消费者线程运行下面的代码，从共享计数器 `count` 中取走一个项目。生产者在同一个互斥锁下增加 `count`，并调用 `pthread_cond_signal`。

为什么 wait 要放在 `while (count == 0)` 里，而不是 `if (count == 0)` 里？

text.en: When `pthread_cond_wait` returns, the condition may be false again: the wake-up may be spurious, or another consumer may have taken the item first. The thread must test again while holding the mutex.
text.zh: `pthread_cond_wait` 返回时条件可能又变回假：唤醒可能是虚假的，也可能另一个消费者先把项目取走了。线程必须在持有互斥锁的情况下重新检查。

why.en: A wake-up only says "the condition might be true". The thread must lock the mutex again to return, and by then the state may have changed. Re-checking in a loop makes the code correct in every case.
why.zh: 唤醒只表示“条件可能为真”。线程必须重新获得互斥锁才能返回，而此时状态可能已经变了。在循环里重新检查，才能保证各种情况下代码都正确。

text.en: `pthread_cond_wait` releases the mutex only on the first iteration, so a loop is needed to release it again.
text.zh: `pthread_cond_wait` 只在第一次迭代时释放互斥锁，所以需要循环来再次释放。

why.en: Each call to `pthread_cond_wait` atomically unlocks the mutex and sleeps, and locks it again before returning. The loop has nothing to do with that.
why.zh: 每次调用 `pthread_cond_wait` 都会原子地解锁并睡眠，返回前再重新加锁。循环与此无关。

text.en: A `while` loop is faster than `if` because it avoids the system call.
text.zh: `while` 循环比 `if` 快，因为它避免了系统调用。

why.en: The loop adds no speed. It can make the thread call `pthread_cond_wait` more than once.
why.zh: 循环不会更快，反而可能让线程多次调用 `pthread_cond_wait`。

text.en: `pthread_cond_signal` wakes every waiting thread, so each of them must loop until it can run alone.
text.zh: `pthread_cond_signal` 会唤醒所有等待的线程，所以每个线程都要循环，直到可以独自运行。

why.en: `pthread_cond_signal` wakes at least one waiter (`pthread_cond_broadcast` wakes all). Even with one woken thread, the loop is still needed for the reasons above.
why.zh: `pthread_cond_signal` 至少唤醒一个等待者（`pthread_cond_broadcast` 才唤醒全部）。即使只唤醒一个线程，前面所说的原因也使循环必不可少。

solution.en: The standard pattern is: lock; while (!predicate) wait; use the shared state; unlock. The predicate is the truth; the signal is only a hint.
solution.zh: 标准写法是：加锁；while (!条件) wait；使用共享状态；解锁。真正的依据是条件本身，信号只是一个提示。

title.en: Which change makes the deadlock impossible
title.zh: 哪种改动可以彻底避免死锁

prompt.en:
Thread 1 locks A, then B, does its work, then unlocks both. Thread 2 locks B, then A, does its work, then unlocks both. The work needs both mutexes held. Sometimes the program hangs.

Which change makes the deadlock impossible while keeping the work protected?
prompt.zh:
线程 1 先锁 A，再锁 B，做完工作后解锁两者。线程 2 先锁 B，再锁 A，做完工作后解锁两者。工作需要同时持有两个互斥锁。程序有时会卡住。

下面哪种改动能在保持工作受保护的前提下彻底避免死锁？

text.en: Change thread 2 to lock A first and then B, so both threads use the same global order.
text.zh: 把线程 2 改成先锁 A 再锁 B，让两个线程使用同一个全局顺序。

why.en: With one fixed order, a cycle of waiting threads cannot form. Whoever holds A is the only one that may ask for B, and B's holder never waits for A.
why.zh: 有了统一的固定顺序，就不可能形成等待环。持有 A 的线程才可能去申请 B，而持有 B 的线程不会再等 A。

text.en: Insert a one-second `sleep` before each second lock.
text.zh: 在每个线程的第二次加锁之前插入一秒 `sleep`。

why.en: Sleeping changes the timing, not the structure. Both threads can still end up holding one lock each; it only becomes less likely.
why.zh: sleep 只改变时间，不改变结构。两个线程仍然可能各持有一个锁，只是概率变小了。

text.en: Make each thread unlock its first mutex before taking the second one.
text.zh: 让每个线程在获取第二个互斥锁之前先释放第一个。

why.en: That removes hold-and-wait, but the work then runs without the first mutex held, so the shared state is no longer protected.
why.zh: 这样确实消除了“持有并等待”，但工作就在没有持有第一个锁的情况下运行，共享状态也就不再受保护。

text.en: Use `pthread_mutex_trylock` for the second lock and run the work anyway if it fails.
text.zh: 第二次加锁用 `pthread_mutex_trylock`，失败了也照样执行工作。

why.en: Running the work without the lock breaks mutual exclusion and brings back data races.
why.zh: 没有持有锁就执行工作，会破坏互斥，并重新引入数据竞争。

solution.en: A deadlock needs four things at once: mutual exclusion, hold-and-wait, no preemption, and a circular wait. A fixed lock order breaks the circular wait, which is the cheapest condition to break. If you must lock mutexes in a data-dependent order (for example two accounts), sort them first, for example by address or id.
solution.zh: 死锁需要同时满足四个条件：互斥、持有并等待、不可抢占、循环等待。固定的加锁顺序打破的是循环等待，这是代价最小的做法。如果必须按依赖于数据的顺序加锁（例如两个账户），就先排序，例如按地址或编号。

title.en: A function defined in a header
title.zh: 定义在头文件里的函数

prompt.en:
The header `util.h` contains this definition, with no `static` and no `inline`:

    int twice(int x) { return 2 * x; }

Both `a.c` and `b.c` include `util.h` and call `twice`. Each file compiles without error on its own. The two object files are then linked into one program.

What happens?
prompt.zh:
头文件 `util.h` 中有下面这个定义，没有 `static`，也没有 `inline`：

    int twice(int x) { return 2 * x; }

`a.c` 和 `b.c` 都包含 `util.h` 并调用 `twice`。每个文件单独编译都没有错误。然后两个目标文件被链接成一个程序。

会发生什么？

text.en: The linker reports that `twice` is defined more than once.
text.zh: 链接器报告 `twice` 被定义了多次。

why.en: #include pastes the header text into each source file, so each object file contains its own external definition of `twice`. A program may have only one definition of an external function.
why.zh: #include 把头文件的文字粘贴进每个源文件，所以每个目标文件都包含一份 `twice` 的外部定义。一个程序中同一个外部函数只能有一个定义。

text.en: The program links and each file gets its own private copy of `twice`.
text.zh: 程序链接成功，每个文件都有自己私有的 `twice`。

why.en: Only a `static` function would be private to its file. Without `static` the name has external linkage, and the two copies clash.
why.zh: 只有 `static` 函数才是文件私有的。没有 `static` 时这个名字具有外部链接，两份定义会冲突。

text.en: The compiler reports a redefinition error when it compiles `b.c`.
text.zh: 编译 `b.c` 时编译器报告重复定义错误。

why.en: Each .c file is compiled separately, and in each of them `twice` appears once. The clash only becomes visible when the objects are combined.
why.zh: 每个 .c 文件是单独编译的，在其中 `twice` 都只出现一次。只有把目标文件合在一起时冲突才会显现。

text.en: The program links, and each call reaches one of the two copies at random.
text.zh: 程序链接成功，每次调用随机落到两份副本之一。

why.en: The linker never links two definitions of one external name. There is no random choice.
why.zh: 链接器不会接受同一个外部名字的两个定义，也不存在随机选择。

solution.en: Put declarations in headers and definitions in exactly one .c file. If a small function must live in a header, make it `static` (or `static inline`): then each translation unit has its own private copy and the linker sees no clash.
solution.zh: 头文件中放声明，定义只放在一个 .c 文件里。如果一个小函数必须放在头文件里，就把它写成 `static`（或 `static inline`）：这样每个翻译单元都有自己的私有副本，链接器就看不到冲突。

questions.verify_code:
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

CC = shutil.which('clang') or shutil.which('cc')


def build(header):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        d = pathlib.Path(tmp)
        (d / 'util.h').write_text(header)
        (d / 'a.c').write_text('#include "util.h"\nint a_val(void) { return twice(2); }\n')
        (d / 'b.c').write_text('#include "util.h"\nint b_val(void) { return twice(3); }\n')
        (d / 'main.c').write_text('#include <stdio.h>\nint a_val(void);\nint b_val(void);\nint main(void) { printf("%d %d\\n", a_val(), b_val()); return 0; }\n')
        for name in ('a', 'b', 'main'):
            done = subprocess.run([CC, '-std=c11', '-c', name + '.c', '-o', name + '.o'], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
            assert done.returncode == 0, done.stderr
        done = subprocess.run([CC, 'a.o', 'b.o', 'main.o', '-o', 'prog'], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
        if done.returncode != 0:
            return 'link error'
        return subprocess.run(['./prog'], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()


print('plain:', build('int twice(int x) { return 2 * x; }\n'))
print('static:', build('static int twice(int x) { return 2 * x; }\n'))

title.en: A macro with half its parentheses
title.zh: 只加了一半括号的宏

prompt.en: What does this program print?
prompt.zh: 这个程序输出什么？

why.en: The preprocessor only replaces text. `60 / SQUARE(3)` becomes `60 / (3) * (3)`. Division and multiplication group from left to right: (60 / 3) * 3 = 60.
why.zh: 预处理器只做文本替换。`60 / SQUARE(3)` 变成 `60 / (3) * (3)`。除法和乘法从左向右结合：(60 / 3) * 3 = 60。

why.en: This is what a function would give: 60 / (3 * 3). A macro does not wrap its result in parentheses unless you write them.
why.zh: 这是函数调用会得到的结果：60 / (3 * 3)。宏不会自动给结果加括号，除非你自己写上。

why.en: This stops after 60 / 3. The multiplication by (3) still follows.
why.zh: 这只算到 60 / 3。后面还要乘以 (3)。

text.en: The program does not compile.
text.zh: 程序无法编译。

why.en: The expanded text `60 / (3) * (3)` is perfectly valid C.
why.zh: 展开后的文字 `60 / (3) * (3)` 是完全合法的 C 代码。

solution.en: Parenthesise each use of a parameter and the whole replacement text: `#define SQUARE(x) ((x) * (x))`. With that, `60 / SQUARE(3)` expands to `60 / ((3) * (3))`, which is 6. Even then, a call like `SQUARE(i++)` evaluates its argument twice, so avoid side effects in macro arguments.
solution.zh: 给参数的每次使用加括号，并给整个替换文字加括号：`#define SQUARE(x) ((x) * (x))`。这样 `60 / SQUARE(3)` 展开为 `60 / ((3) * (3))`，结果是 6。即使这样，`SQUARE(i++)` 这样的调用也会对参数求值两次，所以宏的参数不要有副作用。

title.en: Which line is well defined
title.zh: 哪一行的行为是有定义的

prompt.en: Assume `int` is 32 bits. Exactly one of the following code fragments has fully defined behaviour. Which one?
prompt.zh: 假设 `int` 是 32 位。下面的代码片段中，只有一个的行为是完全有定义的。是哪一个？

text.en: `unsigned u = 0; u = u - 1;`
text.zh: `unsigned u = 0; u = u - 1;`

why.en: Unsigned arithmetic wraps modulo 2^32, by definition. The result is UINT_MAX.
why.zh: 无符号运算按定义是对 2^32 取模回绕的。结果是 UINT_MAX。

text.en: `int i = INT_MAX; i = i + 1;`
text.zh: `int i = INT_MAX; i = i + 1;`

why.en: Signed overflow is undefined behaviour. The compiler may assume it never happens.
why.zh: 有符号整数溢出是未定义行为。编译器可以假定它永远不会发生。

why.en: Valid indexes are 0 to 2. Reading a[3] is outside the array.
why.zh: 合法下标是 0 到 2。读取 a[3] 超出了数组范围。

why.en: Changing a string literal is undefined behaviour; the literal may be in read-only memory. `char s[] = "hi";` would be fine.
why.zh: 修改字符串字面量是未定义行为，字面量可能位于只读内存中。写成 `char s[] = "hi";` 才没有问题。

solution.en: Undefined behaviour is not "an error you will see". The program may appear to work, give a wrong answer, or crash, and a different compiler or optimisation level may change that. Learn the usual sources: signed overflow, out-of-bounds access, using a freed or uninitialised pointer, writing to a literal, and data races.
solution.zh: 未定义行为并不是“你一定会看到的错误”。程序可能看起来正常，也可能给出错误答案或崩溃，换一个编译器或优化级别结果还可能不同。要记住常见的来源：有符号溢出、越界访问、使用已释放或未初始化的指针、写字符串字面量，以及数据竞争。

title.en: Passing the loop variable to threads
title.zh: 把循环变量传给线程

prompt.en:
Each thread runs `worker`, which reads `*(int *)arg` and prints it. The main thread then joins all three threads.

What is wrong with this program?
prompt.zh:
每个线程运行 `worker`，它读取 `*(int *)arg` 并打印。主线程随后等待所有三个线程结束。

这个程序有什么问题？

text.en: All three threads receive the address of the same variable `i`, which the loop keeps changing and which stops existing when the loop ends. A thread may read the wrong value or a dead variable.
text.zh: 三个线程收到的是同一个变量 `i` 的地址，而循环不断修改它，循环结束后它就不再存在了。线程可能读到错误的值，或者读到已经不存在的变量。

why.en: pthread_create passes the pointer itself, not a copy of what it points to. Each thread needs storage that is its own and lives until the thread has read it, for example an array `int ids[3]`.
why.zh: pthread_create 传递的是指针本身，而不是它所指内容的副本。每个线程需要属于自己、并且在线程读取完之前一直存在的存储，例如数组 `int ids[3]`。

text.en: Nothing: `pthread_create` copies the argument, so each thread has its own `i`.
text.zh: 没有问题：`pthread_create` 会复制参数，所以每个线程都有自己的 `i`。

why.en: It copies the pointer value (the address), not the int. All copies lead to the same variable.
why.zh: 它复制的是指针的值（地址），而不是那个 int。所有副本都指向同一个变量。

text.en: `pthread_create` cannot take the address of a local variable; the argument must be a global.
text.zh: `pthread_create` 不能接受局部变量的地址，参数必须是全局变量。

why.en: The address of a local variable is allowed, as long as the variable is still alive when the thread uses it. Here it is not.
why.zh: 局部变量的地址是允许的，前提是线程使用时这个变量还活着。这里的问题正是它活不到那时。

text.en: The joins must come before the creates, or the threads never start.
text.zh: `pthread_join` 必须放在 `pthread_create` 之前，否则线程不会启动。

why.en: A thread starts when it is created. Join only waits for it to finish.
why.zh: 线程在创建时就启动了。join 只是等待它结束。

solution.en: Two rules for thread arguments: the object must outlive the thread's use of it, and each thread must get its own object if it is going to read different data. A heap-allocated argument that the thread frees, or an array indexed by thread number, both follow these rules.
solution.zh: 线程参数的两条规则：被传递的对象必须比线程使用它的时间活得更久；如果线程要读取不同的数据，每个线程都必须拿到属于自己的对象。由线程自己释放的堆上参数，或者按线程编号索引的数组，都符合这两条规则。

title.en: Speedup when part of the work is serial
title.zh: 部分工作无法并行时的加速比

prompt.en:
On one core a program takes 100 seconds. 25 of those seconds are spent in a part that cannot be run in parallel. The other 75 seconds scale perfectly over any number of cores. Ignore all overhead.

What is the best speedup on 4 cores, to two decimal places?
prompt.zh:
一个程序在单核上运行需要 100 秒，其中 25 秒花在无法并行的部分上。其余 75 秒可以完美地扩展到任意多个核心。忽略所有开销。

在 4 个核心上，最好的加速比是多少（保留两位小数）？

why.en: Time on 4 cores = 25 + 75 / 4 = 43.75 seconds. Speedup = 100 / 43.75 = 2.29.
That would need all of the program to speed up. The serial 25 seconds stay 25 seconds.
why.zh: 那需要整个程序都被加速。串行的 25 秒仍然是 25 秒。

why.en: This subtracts one core for the serial part. Amdahl's law divides only the parallel time, it does not remove a core.
why.zh: 这是为串行部分减去了一个核心。阿姆达尔定律只把并行时间除以核心数，并不是去掉一个核心。

why.en: This is 100 / 75: it drops the 25 serial seconds instead of keeping them, and never divides the 75 parallel seconds by 4.
why.zh: 这是 100 / 75：它把 25 秒的串行部分去掉了，却没有把 75 秒的并行部分除以 4。

solution.en: Speedup = 1 / (s + (1 - s) / p), where s = 0.25 is the serial fraction and p = 4. This gives 1 / (0.25 + 0.1875) = 2.29. With unlimited cores the speedup tends to 1 / s = 4, never more. The serial part, not the number of cores, sets the limit.
solution.zh: 加速比 = 1 / (s + (1 - s) / p)，其中串行比例 s = 0.25，核心数 p = 4。得到 1 / (0.25 + 0.1875) = 2.29。核心数无限多时，加速比趋向 1 / s = 4，不可能更高。决定上限的是串行部分，而不是核心数。

title.en: A lock protocol for bank transfers
title.zh: 银行转账的加锁协议

prompt.en:
A bank program keeps its accounts in an array. Account `i` is `accounts[i]`, with a `balance` and its own mutex `lock`. Many threads call `transfer(from, to, amount)` at the same time.

The rules: a balance is never read or written without its lock; the total money never changes; a balance never goes below 0 (a transfer that would do that is refused and changes nothing).

(a) Describe the locking protocol that `transfer` follows: which locks it takes, in which order, and what it does while it holds them.
(b) Explain why two transfers running at the same moment, 0 to 1 and 1 to 0, cannot deadlock under your protocol.
(c) What special case must `transfer` handle when `from` equals `to`, and why?
prompt.zh:
一个银行程序把账户放在数组里。账户 `i` 是 `accounts[i]`，有一个 `balance` 和它自己的互斥锁 `lock`。很多线程同时调用 `transfer(from, to, amount)`。

规则：不持有锁就不能读写余额；总金额不能改变；余额不能小于 0（会导致这种结果的转账要被拒绝，并且什么都不改）。

（a）描述 `transfer` 遵循的加锁协议：取哪些锁、按什么顺序取、持有锁时做什么。
（b）解释在你的协议下，同时进行的两笔转账（0 转 1 和 1 转 0）为什么不会死锁。
（c）当 `from` 等于 `to` 时，`transfer` 必须处理什么特殊情况，为什么？

solution.en:
(a) Protocol. 1. If from == to, return without locking anything (see (c)). 2. Let first be the smaller of the two ids and second the larger. Lock accounts[first].lock, then accounts[second].lock. 3. While holding both locks, check that accounts[from].balance >= amount. If not, unlock both and report failure. Otherwise subtract amount from the source and add it to the destination. 4. Unlock both locks and report success.

Both locks are held across the check and the update. If the lock were dropped between them, another thread could change the balance after the check and the account could go negative (a check-then-act race). Holding both also means no other thread can see the money "in the air", so the total looks constant.

(b) Every thread takes the lock of the smaller id first. Transfer 0 to 1 and transfer 1 to 0 both ask for account 0 first. Whoever gets it then asks for account 1, which nobody holds while waiting for account 0, so it succeeds. The other one simply waits for account 0. A deadlock needs a cycle: one thread holds a larger id and waits for a smaller one. Under a fixed order no thread ever does that, so there is no cycle. The deadlock condition that is broken is the circular wait.

(c) For from == to the protocol would lock the same mutex twice. A normal (non-recursive) mutex locked twice by the same thread deadlocks or is undefined. So the function must detect it and return (the transfer is a no-op), or lock only once.
solution.zh:
（a）协议。1. 如果 from == to，不加任何锁直接返回（见（c））。2. 令 first 为两个编号中较小的，second 为较大的。先锁 accounts[first].lock，再锁 accounts[second].lock。3. 持有两把锁时，检查 accounts[from].balance >= amount。不满足就解锁两把锁并报告失败；满足就从源账户减去 amount，加到目标账户。4. 解开两把锁并报告成功。

检查和更新期间两把锁一直被持有。如果在两者之间放掉锁，别的线程可能在检查之后改变余额，账户就可能变成负数（先检查后执行的竞争）。同时持有两把锁还意味着其他线程看不到“悬在半空”的钱，总金额看起来始终不变。

（b）每个线程都先取编号较小的账户的锁。0 转 1 和 1 转 0 都先申请账户 0。拿到它的线程接着申请账户 1，而账户 1 并没有被谁持有着去等账户 0，所以申请成功。另一个线程只是在等账户 0。死锁需要一个环：某个线程持有较大编号的锁，却在等较小编号的锁。在固定顺序下没有线程会这样做，所以不存在环。被打破的死锁条件是循环等待。

（c）当 from == to 时，协议会对同一个互斥锁加锁两次。普通（非递归）互斥锁被同一个线程锁两次，会死锁或者行为未定义。所以函数必须检测这种情况并直接返回（转账相当于什么都不做，是空操作），或者只加一次锁。

text.en: One lock per account, and both locks are held across the balance check and the update (no gap between check and act).
text.zh: 每个账户一把锁，并且余额检查和更新期间两把锁都被持有（检查与执行之间没有空隙）。

text.en: A fixed global order: always lock the smaller id first, then the larger.
text.zh: 固定的全局顺序：总是先锁编号较小的，再锁较大的。

text.en: Refuses the transfer when the balance is too small, unlocking both locks and changing nothing.
text.zh: 余额不足时拒绝转账，解开两把锁，且不改变任何东西。

text.en: Argues that no circular wait can form: all threads acquire in increasing id order, and 0-to-1 and 1-to-0 both start with account 0.
text.zh: 论证不可能出现循环等待：所有线程都按编号递增的顺序申请，0 转 1 与 1 转 0 都从账户 0 开始。

text.en: Handles from == to without locking the same mutex twice.
text.zh: 处理 from == to 的情况，不会对同一个互斥锁加锁两次。

mistakes.en: Locking `from` first and `to` second. Two opposite transfers then lock in opposite orders and can deadlock.
mistakes.zh: 先锁 `from` 再锁 `to`。两个方向相反的转账会以相反的顺序加锁，可能死锁。

mistakes.en: Unlocking between the check and the update. Another thread can drain the account in the gap.
mistakes.zh: 在检查和更新之间解锁。别的线程可以在这个空隙里把账户取空。

mistakes.en: Forgetting to unlock on the refusal path, so the accounts stay locked for ever.
mistakes.zh: 拒绝转账的路径上忘了解锁，账户就永远被锁住。

mistakes.en: Using one global lock and claiming it is a per-account protocol. It is correct but serialises all transfers.
mistakes.zh: 用一把全局锁，却说这是按账户加锁的协议。它是正确的，但会让所有转账串行执行。

title.en: A helper that shares one buffer
title.zh: 共享同一个缓冲区的辅助函数

prompt.en:
Mia writes this helper. Two threads run at the same time: thread 1 executes `puts(describe(1))` and thread 2 executes `puts(describe(2))`.

(a) Give one interleaving of the two threads after which the program prints "item #2" twice. Say what is shared.
(b) Mia wraps the `snprintf` call inside `describe` in a mutex. Does that fix the problem? Explain.
(c) Redesign the function so that it is safe to call from many threads. Give the new prototype and say who owns the memory.
prompt.zh:
Mia 写了下面这个辅助函数。两个线程同时运行：线程 1 执行 `puts(describe(1))`，线程 2 执行 `puts(describe(2))`。

（a）给出一种两个线程的交错执行顺序，使得程序两次都打印 "item #2"。说明共享的是什么。
（b）Mia 把 `describe` 里的 `snprintf` 调用用互斥锁包起来。这样能解决问题吗？请解释。
（c）重新设计这个函数，使它可以被许多线程安全调用。给出新的函数原型，并说明谁拥有这块内存。

solution.en:
(a) The shared object is the static array buf: there is only one copy, no matter how many threads call the function. Interleaving: thread 1 runs snprintf, so buf holds "item #1", and describe returns the pointer buf. Before thread 1 reaches puts, thread 2 runs snprintf and overwrites buf with "item #2". Now thread 1 calls puts(buf), then thread 2 calls puts(buf). Both print "item #2". If a write is half done when the other thread reads, the output can even be garbled. Unsynchronised access to the same object by two threads, where one writes, is a data race, and the behaviour is undefined.

(b) No. The mutex only protects the snprintf call. It is released when snprintf finishes, but the caller still holds the pointer buf and reads it afterwards, with no lock. The returned pointer lets the shared state escape from the protected region. The problem is the interface, not a missing lock inside.

(c) Make the storage belong to the caller. For example `void describe_r(int n, char *out, size_t cap)` writes into a buffer that the calling thread owns (for example a local array on its own stack). Each thread uses its own buffer, so nothing is shared. Other valid designs: return a freshly malloc'd string and let the caller free it, or keep the static buffer but make it thread-local (`_Thread_local`), which gives each thread its own copy that stays valid until that thread's next call. The first design is the clearest, because ownership and lifetime are visible in the prototype.
solution.zh:
（a）共享的对象是静态数组 buf：不管有多少线程调用这个函数，它都只有一份。交错顺序：线程 1 执行 snprintf，buf 里是 "item #1"，函数返回指针 buf。在线程 1 执行到 puts 之前，线程 2 执行 snprintf，把 buf 覆盖成 "item #2"。随后线程 1 调用 puts(buf)，线程 2 也调用 puts(buf)。两次都打印 "item #2"。如果一个写入进行到一半时另一个线程来读，输出甚至可能是乱码。两个线程对同一个对象进行无同步的访问且其中一个在写，就是数据竞争，行为未定义。

（b）不能。互斥锁只保护 snprintf 这一次调用。snprintf 结束时锁就被释放了，而调用者仍然持有指针 buf，并在之后没有加锁的情况下读取它。返回的指针让共享状态逃出了受保护的区域。问题出在接口设计上，而不是函数内部少了一把锁。

（c）让存储归调用者所有。例如 `void describe_r(int n, char *out, size_t cap)`，把结果写进调用线程自己拥有的缓冲区（例如它自己栈上的局部数组）。每个线程使用自己的缓冲区，就没有任何东西被共享。其他可行的设计：返回一个新 malloc 的字符串，由调用者 free；或者保留静态缓冲区但把它改成线程局部的（`_Thread_local`），这样每个线程有自己的一份，在该线程下一次调用之前一直有效。第一种设计最清楚，因为所有权和生命周期在原型里就看得见。

text.en: Names the shared object (the one static buffer) and gives a valid interleaving: both writes happen before either puts.
text.zh: 指出共享对象（那一个静态缓冲区），并给出有效的交错顺序：两次写入都发生在任何一次 puts 之前。

text.en: Calls it a data race on mutable static state, with undefined behaviour or wrong output.
text.zh: 指出这是对可变静态状态的数据竞争，行为未定义或输出错误。

text.en: Explains why a mutex inside the function is not enough: the returned pointer is used after the lock is released.
text.zh: 解释为什么函数内部加锁还不够：返回的指针在锁释放之后才被使用。

text.en: Gives a redesign without shared storage: caller-owned buffer, heap string returned to the caller, or a thread-local buffer.
text.zh: 给出不共享存储的重新设计：调用者拥有的缓冲区、返回给调用者的堆字符串，或线程局部缓冲区。

mistakes.en: Saying `volatile` or a smaller buffer fixes it. Neither stops two threads sharing one array.
mistakes.zh: 说加 `volatile` 或缩小缓冲区就能解决。两者都不能阻止两个线程共用一个数组。

mistakes.en: Thinking the problem only occurs on a multi-core machine. A thread switch between snprintf and puts causes it on one core too.
mistakes.zh: 以为只有多核机器上才会出问题。在 snprintf 和 puts 之间发生线程切换，单核上同样会出错。

mistakes.en: Locking inside describe and calling it done. The pointer leaves the protected region.
mistakes.zh: 只在 describe 内部加锁就认为结束了。指针已经离开了受保护的区域。

mistakes.en: Redesigning but still returning a pointer into a static array.
mistakes.zh: 重新设计了，却仍然返回指向静态数组的指针。

title.en: Find every leak and the double free
title.zh: 找出所有泄漏和重复释放

prompt.en:
The program below reads the first line of a file into a new heap string. Assume the files open or fail to open at random, and that `malloc` and `fgets` can fail too.

(a) List every line where memory or a file handle is leaked, or where memory is freed twice. For each, say which resource is affected.
(b) Write a corrected `read_first_line` in which every path releases what it acquired.
(c) State the ownership rule that `main` must follow for the string it receives.
prompt.zh:
下面的程序把一个文件的第一行读进新的堆字符串。假设文件可能打开成功也可能失败，并且 `malloc` 和 `fgets` 也可能失败。

（a）列出所有发生内存或文件句柄泄漏、或者内存被重复释放的行。每一处都要说明受影响的是哪个资源。
（b）写出修正后的 `read_first_line`，使每条路径都会释放自己获得的资源。
（c）说明 `main` 对收到的字符串必须遵守的所有权规则。

text.en: Line 12: leaks the open file handle.
text.zh: 第 12 行：泄漏了打开的文件句柄。

text.en: Line 15: leaks both buf and the file handle.
text.zh: 第 15 行：buf 和文件句柄都泄漏了。

text.en: Line 25: the first string is lost when `name` is overwritten.
text.zh: 第 25 行：覆盖 `name` 时丢失了第一个字符串。

text.en: Line 28: double free when the second call succeeded, undefined behaviour.
text.zh: 第 28 行：第二次调用成功时会重复释放，未定义行为。

text.en: Corrected function releases (fclose, free) on every failure path, and on success returns buf with the file closed.
text.zh: 修正后的函数在每条失败路径上都释放资源（fclose、free），成功时关闭文件并返回 buf。

text.en: States the ownership rule: the caller owns the returned string, frees it once, and before reusing the variable.
text.zh: 说明所有权规则：调用者拥有返回的字符串，只释放一次，并且在复用变量之前释放。

mistakes.en: Adding `free(buf)` on the success path before returning it. The caller would then receive a dangling pointer.
mistakes.zh: 在成功路径上返回 buf 之前加了 `free(buf)`。调用者会拿到悬空指针。

mistakes.en: Freeing in the wrong order, or freeing a resource that was never acquired on that path (for example `free(buf)` when malloc failed).
mistakes.zh: 释放的顺序不对，或者释放了该路径上从未获得的资源（例如 malloc 失败时还去 `free(buf)`）。

mistakes.en: Leaving out `fclose` on the failing paths because "the program ends anyway". Long-running programs run out of handles.
mistakes.zh: 失败路径上不写 `fclose`，理由是“程序反正要结束”。长期运行的程序会耗尽文件句柄。

mistakes.en: Setting `name = NULL` without freeing first, which hides the leak instead of fixing it.
mistakes.zh: 没有先释放就把 `name = NULL`，这只是掩盖了泄漏而没有修复它。

title.en: A Makefile for three source files
title.zh: 三个源文件的 Makefile

prompt.en:
A project has these files: `main.c` (includes `list.h` and `util.h`), `list.c` (includes `list.h`), `util.c` (includes `util.h`), and the two headers.

Write a Makefile that builds the program `tool` with these rules:
- Compile with `cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -g`, with the options kept in a variable.
- Each object file is built from its own .c file and is rebuilt when that .c file or any header it includes changes.
- `make` with no argument builds `tool`.
- `make clean` removes the object files and `tool`. It must still work if a file named `clean` exists.

Then explain in one or two sentences why an object file must list its headers as prerequisites.
prompt.zh:
一个项目包含这些文件：`main.c`（包含 `list.h` 和 `util.h`）、`list.c`（包含 `list.h`）、`util.c`（包含 `util.h`），以及两个头文件。

写一个 Makefile，按下面的规则构建程序 `tool`：
- 用 `cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -g` 编译，编译选项放在一个变量里。
- 每个目标文件由自己的 .c 文件生成，并且在该 .c 文件或它包含的任何头文件改变时重新生成。
- 直接运行 `make`（不带参数）会构建 `tool`。
- `make clean` 删除目标文件和 `tool`。即使存在名为 `clean` 的文件，它也必须能工作。

然后用一两句话解释，为什么目标文件必须把它的头文件列为依赖。

solution.en:
CC = cc
CFLAGS = -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -g
OBJS = main.o list.o util.o

tool: $(OBJS)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o tool $(OBJS)

main.o: main.c list.h util.h
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c main.c

list.o: list.c list.h
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c list.c

util.o: util.c util.h
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c util.c

.PHONY: clean
clean:
	rm -f $(OBJS) tool

The first rule in the file (tool) is the default target, so plain `make` builds it. The command lines must start with a tab character, not spaces. The option -c compiles one file to an object file without linking; the final rule links the objects into the program.

Why headers: make decides what to rebuild by comparing file times. A header is pasted into the source file by the preprocessor, so a change in util.h changes what main.c and util.c compile to. If util.h is not listed, make sees main.o as up to date and keeps an object built with the old declarations, which can give wrong behaviour that no compile error reveals. `.PHONY: clean` tells make that clean is a command name, not a file, so the rule runs even if a file called clean exists.
solution.zh:
CC = cc
CFLAGS = -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -g
OBJS = main.o list.o util.o

tool: $(OBJS)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o tool $(OBJS)

main.o: main.c list.h util.h
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c main.c

list.o: list.c list.h
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c list.c

util.o: util.c util.h
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c util.c

.PHONY: clean
clean:
	rm -f $(OBJS) tool

文件中的第一条规则（tool）是默认目标，所以直接运行 `make` 会构建它。命令行必须以制表符（Tab）开头，不能用空格。选项 -c 表示只把一个文件编译成目标文件而不链接；最后那条规则把目标文件链接成程序。

为什么要列出头文件：make 通过比较文件的修改时间来决定重建什么。头文件会被预处理器粘贴进源文件，所以 util.h 的改动会改变 main.c 和 util.c 的编译结果。如果没有列出 util.h，make 会认为 main.o 是最新的，继续使用按旧声明编译出来的目标文件，可能产生错误的行为，而且没有任何编译错误提示。`.PHONY: clean` 告诉 make：clean 是命令的名字而不是文件，所以即使存在名为 clean 的文件，这条规则也会执行。

text.en: Variables for the compiler and its options (CC, CFLAGS) used in the commands.
text.zh: 用变量保存编译器及其选项（CC、CFLAGS），并在命令中使用。

text.en: `tool` depends on the three object files and has a link command; it is the first rule.
text.zh: `tool` 依赖三个目标文件，并有链接命令；它是第一条规则。

text.en: Each object rule uses `-c` and lists its .c file and headers correctly: main.o needs list.h and util.h; list.o needs list.h; util.o needs util.h.
text.zh: 每条目标文件规则使用 `-c`，并正确列出 .c 文件和头文件：main.o 需要 list.h 和 util.h；list.o 需要 list.h；util.o 需要 util.h。

text.en: `clean` removes the objects and `tool`, and is declared `.PHONY`.
text.zh: `clean` 删除目标文件和 `tool`，并声明为 `.PHONY`。

text.en: Explains that a header change must trigger a rebuild, or make keeps stale objects.
text.zh: 解释头文件变化必须触发重建，否则 make 会保留过期的目标文件。

mistakes.en: Starting command lines with spaces. Make requires a tab and reports "missing separator".
mistakes.zh: 命令行用空格开头。Make 要求使用制表符，否则报 “missing separator”。

mistakes.en: Listing only the .c file as a prerequisite. Editing a header then does not rebuild anything.
mistakes.zh: 只把 .c 文件列为依赖。修改头文件后什么都不会重建。

mistakes.en: Compiling and linking in one command per object (leaving out `-c`) so the link fails with undefined or duplicate main.
mistakes.zh: 每个目标文件都在一条命令里既编译又链接（漏了 `-c`），链接时出现 main 未定义或重复。

mistakes.en: Forgetting `.PHONY: clean`, so a file named clean stops the target from running.
mistakes.zh: 忘了 `.PHONY: clean`，一旦有名为 clean 的文件，这个目标就不再运行。

title.en: Reading three compiler warnings
title.zh: 阅读三条编译器警告

prompt.en:
The file below, `sum.c`, is compiled with `clang -Wall -Wextra -std=c11 -c sum.c`. The compiler prints these three warnings (shortened):

sum.c:8:27: warning: format specifies type 'int' but the argument has type 'long' [-Wformat]
sum.c:9:1: warning: non-void function does not return a value [-Wreturn-type]
sum.c:6:9: warning: variable 'total' is uninitialized when used here [-Wuninitialized]

For each warning: say in plain words what the compiler is telling you, what can go wrong when the program runs, and how to fix it. Then say whether a build with no warnings proves that the program is correct.
prompt.zh:
下面的文件 `sum.c` 用 `clang -Wall -Wextra -std=c11 -c sum.c` 编译。编译器输出了这三条警告（已缩短）：

sum.c:8:27: warning: format specifies type 'int' but the argument has type 'long' [-Wformat]
sum.c:9:1: warning: non-void function does not return a value [-Wreturn-type]
sum.c:6:9: warning: variable 'total' is uninitialized when used here [-Wuninitialized]

对每条警告：用通俗的话说明编译器在告诉你什么、程序运行时可能出什么问题、如何修复。然后说明没有任何警告的构建是否能证明程序正确。

solution.en:
1. -Wformat (line 8). The format %d promises an int, but the argument total is a long. printf reads the wrong number of bytes for the argument, so it may print a wrong number (or worse, misread the arguments that follow). Fix: use %ld for a long.

2. -Wreturn-type (line 9). The function is declared to return a long, but control reaches the closing brace with no return statement. If the caller uses the result, that is undefined behaviour. Fix: add `return total;` at the end (and, if the print is only for debugging, remove it).

3. -Wuninitialized (line 6). A local variable without an initialiser has an indeterminate value. The statement total += v[i] reads that value on the first iteration, so the sum starts from garbage and the result is unpredictable. Fix: write long total = 0;.

A warning-free build proves little. Warnings come from the compiler's checks on the source, which can only find some mistakes. Logic errors (wrong loop bound, wrong algorithm), most memory errors and data races compile cleanly. Warnings are cheap evidence, so build with -Wall -Wextra and fix them, even use -Werror in a project, and then test and use tools such as a sanitizer for the rest.
solution.zh:
1. -Wformat（第 8 行）。格式 %d 承诺参数是 int，但实际参数 total 是 long。printf 会按错误的字节数读取这个参数，可能打印出错误的数字（更糟时还会读错后面的参数）。修复：对 long 使用 %ld。

2. -Wreturn-type（第 9 行）。函数声明返回 long，但执行流到达结束的大括号时没有 return 语句。如果调用者使用了返回值，就是未定义行为。修复：在末尾加上 `return total;`（如果这行打印只是调试用的，可以删掉）。

3. -Wuninitialized（第 6 行）。没有初始化的局部变量的值是不确定的。语句 total += v[i] 在第一次迭代时就读取这个值，所以求和是从垃圾值开始的，结果不可预测。修复：写成 long total = 0;。

没有警告的构建几乎不能证明什么。警告来自编译器对源代码的检查，这些检查只能发现一部分错误。逻辑错误（循环边界错、算法错）、大多数内存错误和数据竞争都能干净地通过编译。警告是代价很低的证据，所以编译时要开 -Wall -Wextra 并修掉警告，项目中甚至可以用 -Werror，然后再用测试和 sanitizer 等工具检查其余的问题。

text.en: -Wformat: %d versus long; wrong output or misread arguments; use %ld.
text.zh: -Wformat：%d 与 long 不匹配；输出错误或参数被读错；改用 %ld。

text.en: -Wreturn-type: falls off the end of a non-void function, undefined if the value is used; add `return total;`.
text.zh: -Wreturn-type：非 void 函数没有返回就走到末尾，使用返回值时行为未定义；加上 `return total;`。

text.en: -Wuninitialized: total starts indeterminate, the sum is garbage; initialise to 0.
text.zh: -Wuninitialized：total 初始值不确定，求和结果是垃圾值；初始化为 0。

text.en: Says a clean build does not prove correctness (logic errors, memory errors and races are not caught) and that warnings should still be fixed.
text.zh: 指出没有警告并不能证明正确（逻辑错误、内存错误和数据竞争查不出来），但警告仍应修复。

mistakes.en: Silencing a warning with a cast instead of fixing the cause, for example casting total to int and losing digits.
mistakes.zh: 用类型转换压掉警告而不是修复原因，例如把 total 转成 int 而丢失数位。

mistakes.en: Reading only the first warning and stopping. Later lines may point at the real cause.
mistakes.zh: 只看第一条警告就停下来。后面的几行可能才指出真正的原因。

mistakes.en: Believing that the warning in line 9 means the closing brace is the problem. The problem is the missing return value.
mistakes.zh: 以为第 9 行的警告说明那个大括号有问题。真正的问题是缺少返回值。

title.en: Reading an AddressSanitizer report
title.zh: 阅读 AddressSanitizer 报告

prompt.en:
The program below was built with `clang -g -fsanitize=address`. Running it printed this report (shortened; the numbers are addresses):

==2018==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow on address 0x602000000098 ...
WRITE of size 9 at 0x602000000098 thread T0
    #0 0x103435b74 in strcpy+0x510 (libclang_rt.asan_osx_dynamic.dylib:arm64e+0x4db74)
    #1 0x102b83d8c in copy_text asan.c:7
    #2 0x102b83d2c in main asan.c:12

0x602000000098 is located 0 bytes after 8-byte region [0x602000000090,0x602000000098)
allocated by thread T0 here:
    #0 0x10343cc04 in malloc+0x94 (libclang_rt.asan_osx_dynamic.dylib:arm64e+0x54c04)
    #1 0x102b83d7c in copy_text asan.c:6
    #2 0x102b83d2c in main asan.c:12

SUMMARY: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow ... in strcpy+0x510

(a) What kind of error is it, and what operation caused it?
(b) Which line of the source performed the bad write, and which line allocated the block?
(c) How large is the block, and how many bytes did the write try to store? Why do these two numbers explain "0 bytes after"?
(d) Fix the bug.
(e) Why might the program seem to work correctly without the sanitizer?
prompt.zh:
下面的程序用 `clang -g -fsanitize=address` 构建。运行时打印了这份报告（已缩短；数字是地址）：

==2018==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow on address 0x602000000098 ...
WRITE of size 9 at 0x602000000098 thread T0
    #0 0x103435b74 in strcpy+0x510 (libclang_rt.asan_osx_dynamic.dylib:arm64e+0x4db74)
    #1 0x102b83d8c in copy_text asan.c:7
    #2 0x102b83d2c in main asan.c:12

0x602000000098 is located 0 bytes after 8-byte region [0x602000000090,0x602000000098)
allocated by thread T0 here:
    #0 0x10343cc04 in malloc+0x94 (libclang_rt.asan_osx_dynamic.dylib:arm64e+0x54c04)
    #1 0x102b83d7c in copy_text asan.c:6
    #2 0x102b83d2c in main asan.c:12

SUMMARY: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow ... in strcpy+0x510

（a）这是哪一类错误，由什么操作引起？
（b）源代码中哪一行执行了错误的写入，哪一行分配了这个内存块？
（c）这个内存块有多大，这次写入打算存多少字节？这两个数字为什么能解释“0 bytes after”？
（d）修复这个 bug。
（e）为什么没有 sanitizer 时程序可能看起来一切正常？

solution.en:
(a) A heap-buffer-overflow: the program wrote (WRITE) past the end of a heap block. The operation was strcpy.

(b) Read the call stack from the top. Frame #0 is inside the library function strcpy; the first frame in our own code is #1: copy_text at asan.c line 7, which is the strcpy call, called from main at line 12. The second stack ("allocated by") shows the block was created by malloc in copy_text at asan.c line 6.

(c) The block is 8 bytes (the region [0x...090, 0x...098)). The text "Leon-Mia" has 8 characters, and strcpy copies 9 bytes: the 8 characters plus the terminator. The ninth byte falls just outside the block, at the first address after it, so the report says "0 bytes after".

(d) The bug is that malloc(strlen(s)) forgets the terminator. Fix: char *copy = malloc(strlen(s) + 1); and check that it is not NULL before copying. (strdup does the sizing and the copy for you; you still check its result for NULL.)

(e) Without the sanitizer, malloc usually rounds block sizes up (for example to a multiple of 8 or 16), so one extra byte lands in padding that nobody uses. The write still breaks the rules, but nothing visible happens. With another string length, or another allocator, the same code overwrites a neighbouring block or crashes later, far from the cause. Undefined behaviour does not promise a crash.
solution.zh:
（a）这是 heap-buffer-overflow（堆缓冲区溢出）：程序对堆块末尾之外进行了写入（WRITE）。引起它的操作是 strcpy。

（b）调用栈要从上往下读。帧 #0 在库函数 strcpy 内部；我们自己代码里的第一帧是 #1：asan.c 第 7 行的 copy_text，也就是 strcpy 调用，它由 main 在第 12 行调用。第二份栈（“allocated by”）显示这个内存块是 copy_text 在 asan.c 第 6 行通过 malloc 创建的。

（c）内存块是 8 字节（区间 [0x...090, 0x...098)）。文本 "Leon-Mia" 有 8 个字符，而 strcpy 要复制 9 个字节：8 个字符加终止符。第九个字节落在块外面，正好是块之后的第一个地址，所以报告写的是“0 bytes after”。

（d）错误在于 malloc(strlen(s)) 忘了终止符。修复：char *copy = malloc(strlen(s) + 1); 并且在复制之前检查它不是 NULL。（strdup 替你完成大小计算和复制，但你仍然要检查它的返回值是否为 NULL。）

（e）没有 sanitizer 时，malloc 通常会把块的大小向上取整（例如取整到 8 或 16 的倍数），所以多出来的一个字节落在没人使用的填充区里。这次写入仍然违反了规则，但看不到任何后果。换一个字符串长度或换一个分配器，同样的代码就会覆盖相邻的块，或者在离原因很远的地方崩溃。未定义行为并不保证会崩溃。

text.en: Identifies a heap-buffer-overflow caused by a write in strcpy.
text.zh: 指出这是由 strcpy 中的写入引起的堆缓冲区溢出。

text.en: Finds the bad write in copy_text at line 7 (frame #1, the first frame in the program's own code).
text.zh: 找到出错的写入在 copy_text 的第 7 行（帧 #1，程序自己代码中的第一帧）。

text.en: Finds the allocation at line 6 (malloc in copy_text).
text.zh: 找到分配发生在第 6 行（copy_text 中的 malloc）。

text.en: Explains the numbers: 8-byte block, 9 bytes written (8 characters plus the terminator), so the last byte is just after the block.
text.zh: 解释这些数字：块为 8 字节，写入 9 字节（8 个字符加终止符），所以最后一个字节正好在块之后。

text.en: Names the root cause: size computed as strlen(s) without + 1.
text.zh: 指出根本原因：大小只算了 strlen(s)，没有加 1。

text.en: Gives the fix: malloc(strlen(s) + 1), with a NULL check (or strdup).
text.zh: 给出修复：malloc(strlen(s) + 1)，并检查 NULL（或使用 strdup）。

text.en: Explains why it can seem fine without the sanitizer: allocator padding, and undefined behaviour does not promise a crash.
text.zh: 解释为什么没有 sanitizer 时看起来正常：分配器有填充，而且未定义行为不保证崩溃。

mistakes.en: Reading frame #0 as the line to fix. It is inside the library; the error is in the call from our code, frame #1.
mistakes.zh: 把帧 #0 当成要修改的那一行。它在库函数内部，错误出在我们代码中的调用，也就是帧 #1。

mistakes.en: Increasing the malloc size by a guess (for example +8) and not understanding why 9 bytes are needed.
mistakes.zh: 凭猜测把 malloc 的大小加上一个数（例如 +8），却不明白为什么需要 9 字节。

mistakes.en: Concluding that the program is fine because it printed "Leon-Mia" correctly when run without ASan.
mistakes.zh: 因为不用 ASan 运行时正确打印了 "Leon-Mia"，就断定程序没问题。

title.en: Diagnostic: C, processes and threads
title.zh: 诊断测验：C、进程与线程

note.en: About 20 minutes, spread over all four stages of the course: C objects and data, building and running programs, communication and synchronisation, and parallel performance. Almost everything is marked for you, so it shows quickly which chapters need work. This is an original practice quiz written for this site. It is not a guide to the format, length or content of any real exam.
note.zh: 大约 20 分钟，覆盖课程的四个阶段：C 对象与数据、构建与运行程序、通信与同步、并行性能。几乎全部题目都会自动判分，所以能很快看出哪些章节需要加强。这是为本站原创的练习测验，并不是任何真实考试的格式、时长或内容的指南。

title.en: Mock paper: C, processes and threads
title.zh: 模拟试卷：C、进程与线程

note.en: About 90 minutes and 85 marks, mixed kinds: six multiple choice, three trace tables, two memory diagrams, three functions to write, one bug to find and two short answers. Do the writing questions on paper first and type them in afterwards to run the tests. This is an original practice paper written for this site. It is not a guide to the format, length or marking of any real exam.
note.zh: 大约 90 分钟、85 分，题型混合：六道选择题、三道跟踪表、两道内存图、三个要写的函数、一道找错题和两道简答题。写代码的题先在纸上做，之后再敲进去运行测试。这是为本站原创的练习试卷，并不是任何真实考试的格式、时长或评分方式的指南。

title.en: Handwriting paper: tables, diagrams and C functions
title.zh: 手写练习：跟踪表、内存图与 C 函数

note.en: About 45 minutes of work with pen and paper: two trace tables, one memory diagram, one bug to find, and three C functions to write. No notes, no compiler. Mark yourself with the rubrics afterwards. This is an original practice paper written for this site. It is not a guide to the format, length or marking of any real exam.
note.zh: 大约 45 分钟的纸笔练习：两道跟踪表、一道内存图、一道找错题和三个要写的 C 函数。不看笔记，不用编译器。做完后按评分标准给自己打分。这是为本站原创的练习试卷，并不是任何真实考试的格式、时长或评分方式的指南。

title.en: A heap overflow that passes every normal run
title.zh: 正常运行一切都对的堆缓冲区溢出

summary.en: Run a log-line copier that looks correct, let AddressSanitizer name the exact line and block, fix the size, and learn what ASan still cannot see.
summary.zh: 运行一个看起来完全正确的日志行复制器，用 AddressSanitizer 找出确切的行和内存块，修好长度，并弄清 ASan 仍然看不到什么。

scenario.en:
Mia owns a small tool called logcopy. It reads access-log lines and prints an escaped copy of each one: a tab becomes the two characters `\t` and a double quote becomes `\"`. The CSV loader downstream used to choke on those characters. The tool has shipped for a month and nobody has seen a crash.

Jack is adding it to the nightly job and asks you to check it with the sanitizer build before he does. Nothing is known to be wrong. Your job is to find out whether the quiet runs mean the code is correct, or only that the bug has not been loud yet.

You will build it two ways, read what AddressSanitizer reports, fix the cause, prove the fix on the worst input, and then see one overflow that ASan misses.
scenario.zh:
Mia 维护一个叫 logcopy 的小工具。它读取访问日志，为每一行打印一份转义后的副本：制表符变成两个字符 `\t`，双引号变成 `\"`。下游的 CSV 加载程序以前会被这些字符搞崩。工具已经上线一个月，没有人见过崩溃。

Jack 想把它放进夜间任务，请你先用 sanitizer（运行时检查工具）构建版本检查一遍。目前没有任何已知问题。你要回答的是：这些安静的运行说明代码正确，还是只说明错误还没有吵起来？

你会用两种方式构建它，读懂 AddressSanitizer 的报告，修掉根因，在最坏输入上证明修复有效，最后看一个 ASan 发现不了的溢出。

title.en: Build it normally and run it
title.zh: 正常构建并运行

body.en:
`-std=c11` fixes the language version, `-Wall -Wextra` turns on the compiler's common warnings, `-g` keeps line numbers for tools, and `-o` names the program. The build is clean and the output is right, including the tab and the quotes. This is what Mia has seen for a month.

The program is still wrong. `malloc(len + 1)` has room for the text and its NUL, but every tab and every quote needs one extra byte for the escape. Line 2 of sample.log has a tab, and line 4 has two quotes. The extra bytes go past the end of the block into memory malloc rounds up and keeps for itself, so nothing crashes. Undefined behaviour does not have to look like a failure.
body.zh:
`-std=c11` 固定语言版本，`-Wall -Wextra` 打开编译器常用的警告，`-g` 为工具保留行号，`-o` 指定程序名。构建没有警告，输出也对，制表符和引号都正确转义。这就是 Mia 一个月来看到的结果。

但程序仍然是错的。`malloc(len + 1)` 只给文本和结尾的 NUL 留了位置，而每个制表符、每个引号还要多一个字节放转义符。sample.log 的第 2 行有一个制表符，第 4 行有两个引号。多出的字节越过块的末尾，写进了 malloc 为了对齐而多留的空间，所以不会崩溃。未定义行为不一定表现为失败。

title.en: Rebuild with AddressSanitizer
title.zh: 用 AddressSanitizer 重新构建

body.en:
`-fsanitize=address` makes the compiler check every memory access against a shadow map and puts guard bytes (red zones) around each heap block. `-fno-omit-frame-pointer` keeps the frame chain so the stack traces are reliable. The source is unchanged. The first bad write stops the program, and the report goes to stderr.

On Linux the process exits with status 1. On macOS ASan aborts instead (status 134). The report text is the same.
body.zh:
`-fsanitize=address` 让编译器用一张影子映射检查每次内存访问，并在每个堆块周围放置保护字节（红区，red zone）。`-fno-omit-frame-pointer` 保留帧指针链，使堆栈跟踪更可靠。源代码没有改动。第一次越界写入就会让程序停止，报告输出到 stderr。

在 Linux 上进程以状态 1 退出；在 macOS 上 ASan 改为 abort（状态 134）。报告内容相同。

title.en: Read the report from the top
title.zh: 从头读这份报告

body.en:
Read it in this order, and stop when you have the answer.

1. The first line names the class of error, `heap-buffer-overflow`, and the address.
2. `WRITE of size 1` says it was a one-byte store, not a read. Stores are the dangerous ones.
3. Frame `#0` is the exact source line that did it, inside `escape_line`. Frame `#1` is the caller.
4. `0 bytes after 53-byte region` is the key line. The block was 53 bytes, which is a 52-character line plus a NUL, and the write landed in the first byte after it.
5. `allocated by thread T0 here` points to the `malloc` call that sized the block.

Now the fix is a question of arithmetic: how many bytes can the output need when the input has `len` characters? Each input byte produces at most two output bytes. The rest of the report (the shadow bytes dump) is for people debugging ASan itself; you rarely need it.
body.zh:
按这个顺序读，得到答案就可以停。

1. 第一行给出错误类别 `heap-buffer-overflow` 和地址。
2. `WRITE of size 1` 说明这是一次单字节写入，不是读取。写入更危险。
3. 帧 `#0` 就是出错的源代码行，在 `escape_line` 里；帧 `#1` 是调用者。
4. `0 bytes after 53-byte region` 是关键一行：这个块是 53 字节（52 个字符的行加一个 NUL），写入落在它后面的第一个字节上。
5. `allocated by thread T0 here` 指向决定了块大小的那次 `malloc`。

现在修复就是一道算术题：输入有 `len` 个字符时，输出最多需要多少字节？每个输入字节最多产生两个输出字节。报告末尾的影子字节（shadow bytes）转储是给调试 ASan 本身的人看的，平时很少需要。

title.en: Fix the size and retest under ASan
title.zh: 修正大小，用 ASan 重测

body.en: The patch sizes the block for the worst case, `2 * len + 1`, and says why in the comment. Rebuild with the sanitizer and run the same file. No report, exit status 0, and the same output as before.
body.zh: 补丁按最坏情况 `2 * len + 1` 分配块，并在注释里写明原因。用 sanitizer 重新构建并运行同一个文件：没有报告，退出状态 0，输出与之前相同。

patch.from: char *out = malloc(len + 1);              /* the text plus its NUL */
patch.to: char *out = malloc(2 * len + 1);          /* worst case: every byte becomes two, plus NUL */

title.en: Prove it on the worst input, and check the output
title.zh: 在最坏输入上验证，并检查输出

body.en:
The old input only touched the bug by a byte or two. worst.log is one line made only of 20 tabs and 10 quotes, so every byte doubles. A pass here is evidence about the bound itself, not about luck.

ASan only says that no invalid access happened. It does not say the output is right. The second command compares the output with expected.txt, which was reviewed by hand. Use both in a nightly job: the sanitizer for memory, a diff for behaviour.
body.zh:
旧输入只越界了一两个字节。worst.log 只有一行，由 20 个制表符和 10 个引号组成，每个字节都会翻倍。这里通过说明的是上界本身成立，而不是运气好。

ASan 只能说明没有发生非法访问，不能说明输出正确。第二条命令把输出和 expected.txt（人工检查过）做比较。夜间任务里两者都要用：sanitizer 管内存，diff 管行为。

steps.command: ./logcopy-asan worst.log && ./logcopy-asan sample.log > actual.txt && diff expected.txt actual.txt && echo "output matches expected.txt"

title.en: Find what ASan does not see
title.zh: 找出 ASan 看不到的错误

body.en:
record.c has a struct with an 8-byte tag followed by an int level. The loop copies the tag from the command line with no bound. "WARN-HIGH" is 9 characters plus a NUL, so it spills 2 bytes into `level`.

Both bytes are still inside the same struct object. ASan puts red zones around objects, not between fields, so it sees nothing wrong. The program exits 0 and prints `level=72`, the ASCII code of `H`, instead of 1. A clean ASan run is not a clean bill of health.
body.zh:
record.c 里有一个结构体：8 字节的 tag 后面跟着 int 类型的 level。循环从命令行复制 tag，没有任何上界。“WARN-HIGH” 是 9 个字符加一个 NUL，所以有 2 个字节溢出到 `level` 里。

这两个字节仍然在同一个结构体对象之内。ASan 把红区放在对象周围，而不是字段之间，所以它什么都没看到。程序以 0 退出，打印 `level=72`（字符 `H` 的 ASCII 码），而不是 1。ASan 运行干净，不等于代码没有问题。

steps.command: clang -std=c11 -g -fsanitize=address record.c -o record-asan && ./record-asan WARN-HIGH; echo "exit status: $?"

title.en: Try a different tool on the same bug
title.zh: 用另一个工具查同一个错误

body.en:
`-fsanitize=bounds` is one of the UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer (UBSan) checks. It knows the declared size of `tag` (`char[8]`) and checks every index against it, even inside a struct. `-fno-sanitize-recover=bounds` makes the first finding stop the program, so a CI job fails instead of printing a warning that nobody reads.

UBSan catches this index; it would not catch the same copy written with `memcpy` through a pointer. Each tool has its own blind spots, which is why teams combine them with tests, fuzzing and review.
body.zh:
`-fsanitize=bounds` 是 UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer（UBSan）的检查项之一。它知道 `tag` 声明的大小（`char[8]`），并对每个下标做检查，结构体内部也不例外。`-fno-sanitize-recover=bounds` 让第一个发现就终止程序，这样 CI 任务会失败，而不是打印一条没人看的警告。

UBSan 能抓住这个下标；如果同样的复制用指针加 `memcpy` 来写，它就抓不到。每个工具都有自己的盲区，所以团队才要把它们与测试、模糊测试和代码评审结合起来。

review.en: Does every allocation size come from the same quantity as the loop that fills it? A comment should state the bound ("at most two output bytes per input byte").
review.zh: 每次分配的大小，是否与填充它的循环出自同一个量？注释应写明上界（例如“每个输入字节最多产生两个输出字节”）。

review.en: When output can be longer than input (escaping, expansion, formatting), has the maximum growth factor been worked out rather than guessed from sample data?
review.zh: 输出可能比输入长时（转义、展开、格式化），是否算出了最大增长倍数，而不是根据样例数据猜？

review.en: Do the tests include the worst case (every byte special, empty input, a line at the maximum length), not just typical lines?
review.zh: 测试是否包含最坏情况（每个字节都是特殊字符、空输入、恰好最大长度的行），而不只是典型的行？

review.en: If a counting pass and a writing pass both exist, can they drift apart? One bound used in both places is safer than two loops that must agree.
review.zh: 如果同时有计数循环和写入循环，它们会不会逐渐不一致？两处共用同一个上界，比两个必须一致的循环更安全。

review.en: Is the size arithmetic safe against overflow (`2 * len + 1` is fine for an fgets buffer; check it when len comes from outside)?
review.zh: 大小的算术是否能防止溢出？（对 fgets 缓冲区来说 `2 * len + 1` 没问题；当 len 来自外部时必须检查。）

review.en: Does CI build and run the tests with `-fsanitize=address,undefined` in a separate build directory, and does it fail on the first report?
review.zh: CI 是否在单独的构建目录里用 `-fsanitize=address,undefined` 构建并运行测试，并在第一个报告处失败？

review.en: Does a sanitizer pass get paired with an output check (diff against a reviewed expected file)? A clean ASan run says nothing about correctness.
review.zh: sanitizer 通过之后，是否还配有输出检查（与人工检查过的期望文件做 diff）？ASan 干净并不说明结果正确。

review.en: Are structs with fixed-size char arrays copied with a bounded function and a length check, since ASan will not notice an overflow between fields?
review.zh: 含固定长度 char 数组的结构体，是否用带上界的函数并检查长度来复制？ASan 不会发现字段之间的溢出。

review.en: Is ownership documented ("caller frees"), and is the NULL return from malloc handled on every path?
review.zh: 所有权是否写明（“由调用者释放”），每条路径是否处理了 malloc 返回 NULL 的情况？

tradeoffs.en:
**Cost of the tool.** ASan typically slows a program by about 2x and uses 2x to 3x the memory, because it checks every access and keeps freed blocks in quarantine. That is acceptable in tests and CI, and not in most production binaries. Production systems that want some of the protection use sampling allocators (for example GWP-ASan) or hardened libc builds, which catch far fewer bugs. Keep sanitizer objects in their own build directory so they never get linked with normal ones. ASan and ThreadSanitizer cannot be combined in one binary; ASan and UBSan can.

**Cost of the fix.** `2 * len + 1` wastes up to half the block for ordinary lines, for a copy that lives for one loop iteration. A counting pass allocates exactly but gives you two loops that must stay in sync, which is how the next off-by-one appears. For a short-lived copy, the simple bound wins. For a large buffer kept in a cache, count first or grow with `realloc`.

**What ASan cannot catch.** It misses overflows between fields of one object (shown above), reads of uninitialised memory (use MemorySanitizer on clang/Linux, or Valgrind), bugs on paths your inputs never run, overflows that jump over the red zone into another live block, memory handed out by your own pool or arena allocator unless you annotate it, and accesses inside libraries that were not built with ASan (libc string functions are intercepted, so those are covered). It does not find logic errors or data races at all. Leak detection is on by default on Linux and not available on Apple Silicon. For the paths your tests never reach, add fuzzing: clang can build the same function with `-fsanitize=fuzzer,address` and feed it generated lines.

**Reading the result.** Exit status differs by platform (1 on Linux, 134 on macOS), and `ASAN_OPTIONS` tunes behaviour (for example `abort_on_error`). A CI script should treat any non-zero status as failure and keep the report as an artifact.
tradeoffs.zh:
**工具的代价。** ASan 通常让程序慢约 2 倍，内存占用约 2 到 3 倍，因为它检查每次访问，还把释放的块放进隔离区。这在测试和 CI 中可以接受，但多数生产二进制不能这样用。想在生产环境得到一部分保护的系统，会使用采样式分配器（例如 GWP-ASan）或加固的 libc，它们能发现的问题少得多。要把 sanitizer 的目标文件放在单独的构建目录，避免和普通对象文件链接在一起。ASan 和 ThreadSanitizer 不能放进同一个二进制；ASan 和 UBSan 可以。

**修复的代价。** 对普通行来说，`2 * len + 1` 最多浪费一半的块，而这份副本只活一次循环迭代。先计数再分配可以精确，但会得到两个必须保持同步的循环，下一个差一错误正是这样出现的。对短命的副本，简单的上界更好。对缓存里长期保存的大缓冲区，应先计数，或用 `realloc` 增长。

**ASan 抓不到什么。** 它抓不到同一对象内字段之间的溢出（上面演示了）、读取未初始化内存（用 clang/Linux 上的 MemorySanitizer，或 Valgrind）、你的输入没有走到的路径、跳过红区落进另一个有效块的溢出、你自己的内存池或 arena 分配器分出去的内存（除非加标注），以及没有用 ASan 构建的库内部的访问（libc 的字符串函数有拦截，所以这部分有覆盖）。它完全找不到逻辑错误和数据竞争。泄漏检测在 Linux 上默认开启，在 Apple Silicon 上不可用。对测试走不到的路径，要加模糊测试：clang 可以用 `-fsanitize=fuzzer,address` 构建同一个函数，并喂给它生成的日志行。

**解读结果。** 退出状态因平台而异（Linux 为 1，macOS 为 134），`ASAN_OPTIONS` 可以调整行为（例如 `abort_on_error`）。CI 脚本应把任何非零状态当作失败，并把报告保存为产物。

done.en: You can explain why the plain run printed correct output while the code was wrong.
done.zh: 你能解释为什么普通运行输出正确，而代码其实是错的。

done.en: You can point to the three lines of an ASan report that give the kind of error, the bad line, and the allocation that was too small.
done.zh: 你能在 ASan 报告里指出三处：错误类别、出错的行、以及过小的那次分配。

done.en: logcopy passes under ASan on sample.log and worst.log, and its output matches expected.txt.
done.zh: logcopy 在 sample.log 和 worst.log 上通过 ASan，且输出与 expected.txt 一致。

done.en: You can name two kinds of bug a clean ASan run does not rule out.
done.zh: 你能说出两类即使 ASan 运行干净也无法排除的错误。

title.en: Find the null behind a segfault with gdb
title.zh: 用 gdb 找出段错误背后的空指针

summary.en: A contact lookup crashes only for some names. Use gdb in batch mode to read the backtrace, inspect the node, find where the null was stored, then fix it and add a regression test.
summary.zh: 联系人查找只在某些名字上崩溃。用 gdb 批处理模式读取回溯、检查节点、找出空指针是在哪里存进去的，然后修复并添加回归测试。

scenario.en:
Emma maintains a small contact tool. It loads a CSV file into a singly linked list, then looks up the names given on the command line. A bug report says: "Looking up Mia works. Looking up Emma crashes. Same file, same binary."

Leon has read the code and says the lookup loop looks right. You cannot guess your way out of this one, so you will let the debugger show you the crash instead. The job has three parts: see where the program died, work out which data it died on, and find where that bad data came from, because the line that crashed is usually not the line that is wrong.
scenario.zh:
Emma 维护一个小的联系人工具。它把 CSV 文件加载进一个单向链表，然后查找命令行里给出的名字。有人提交了缺陷报告：“查 Mia 正常，查 Emma 就崩溃。文件相同，程序相同。”

Leon 读过代码，觉得查找循环看上去没问题。这次靠猜是猜不出来的，所以让调试器来告诉你崩溃发生在哪里。任务分三部分：看清程序死在哪里，弄清它死在哪份数据上，再找出这份坏数据是从哪里来的，因为崩溃的那一行通常并不是出错的那一行。

title.en: Reproduce the crash
title.zh: 复现崩溃

body.en:
`-g` stores source line information in the program so a debugger can show it. `-O0` turns optimisation off so variables stay in memory where gdb can read them; with optimisation on you will see `<optimized out>` for many of them. `-Wall -Wextra` is clean here: the bug is not something the compiler can see.

The braces and `2>/dev/null` hide the shell's own "Segmentation fault" message, which carries a process id. What matters is the exit status. `139` is 128 plus signal 11, the signal for an invalid memory access (SIGSEGV). The first lookup printed its answer, and the second killed the program.
body.zh:
`-g` 把源代码行号信息存进程序，调试器才能显示出来。`-O0` 关闭优化，变量留在内存里，gdb 才读得到；开了优化后你会在很多变量上看到 `<optimized out>`。这里 `-Wall -Wextra` 没有警告：这个错误编译器看不出来。

花括号和 `2>/dev/null` 是为了隐藏 shell 自己打印的 “Segmentation fault” 消息，因为它带有进程号。重要的是退出状态：`139` 等于 128 加信号 11，即无效内存访问的信号（SIGSEGV）。第一次查找打印了结果，第二次让程序死掉了。

steps.command: gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -g -O0 main.c contacts.c list.c -o contacts && { ./contacts contacts.csv Mia Emma; } 2>/dev/null; echo "exit status: $?"

title.en: Let gdb run it and print the backtrace
title.zh: 让 gdb 运行它并打印回溯

body.en:
`-batch` runs the listed commands and exits without an interactive prompt, which makes the session repeatable and easy to paste into a bug report. Each `-ex 'command'` is one gdb command. `--args` says that everything after it is the program and its own arguments. The commands do four things:

- `run` starts the program and stops it at the signal.
- `bt` (backtrace) prints the chain of calls that led to the crash, innermost first.
- `frame 1` selects frame number 1, the caller of the function that crashed.
- `print *node` follows the pointer `node` in that frame and prints the whole struct.

Read frame `#0`: the program died inside the C library, in a string-comparison function (gdb may show a name such as `__strcmp_avx2`, or only `??`, depending on whether debug symbols for the library are installed). There is no source for it here. That tells you `strcmp` was given a bad pointer, but not whose. Frame `#1` is our code, `list_find_by_name`, at the line that calls `strcmp(node->name, wanted)`. In the struct, `name = 0x0`: node id 3 has a NULL name. On macOS, `lldb -b -o run -o bt -o 'frame select 1' -o 'p *node' -- ./contacts ...` is the same session.
body.zh:
`-batch` 运行给出的命令后直接退出，没有交互提示，所以这次会话可以重复，也方便贴进缺陷报告。每个 `-ex '命令'` 是一条 gdb 命令。`--args` 表示它后面的全部内容是被调试的程序及其自己的参数。这几条命令做四件事：

- `run` 启动程序，并在收到信号时让它停住。
- `bt`（backtrace，回溯）打印导致崩溃的调用链，最内层在最前。
- `frame 1` 选中 1 号栈帧，也就是崩溃函数的调用者。
- `print *node` 顺着该栈帧里的指针 `node` 取出并打印整个结构体。

先看帧 `#0`：程序死在 C 库里的字符串比较函数中（根据是否安装了该库的调试符号，gdb 可能显示 `__strcmp_avx2` 这样的名字，也可能只显示 `??`），这里没有它的源代码。这说明 `strcmp` 收到了坏指针，但没说是谁给的。帧 `#1` 是我们自己的代码 `list_find_by_name`，位于调用 `strcmp(node->name, wanted)` 的那一行。结构体里 `name = 0x0`：id 为 3 的节点名字是 NULL。在 macOS 上，`lldb -b -o run -o bt -o 'frame select 1' -o 'p *node' -- ./contacts ...` 是等价的会话。

steps.command: gdb -batch -ex run -ex bt -ex 'frame 1' -ex 'print *node' --args ./contacts contacts.csv Mia Emma

title.en: Ask where the null came from
title.zh: 追问空指针从哪里来

body.en:
The crash site is not the fault site. `list_find_by_name` trusts that every node has a name. The question is who stored a NULL. A conditional breakpoint answers it: `break list_add if name == 0` stops the program only when `list_add` is called with a NULL `name`, and nowhere else. After the stop, `bt` shows the callers and `frame 1` selects the loader. `print row` says which CSV row it was parsing, and `print line` shows the text. The loader has already cut the string at the second comma, so gdb prints a `\000` (a NUL byte) between `3,` and the email.

The row is number 3, `3,,noah@example.test`: the name field is empty, and `contacts_load` turns an empty field into NULL on purpose. The list then accepts it silently. Two places agree on a convention that nothing enforces.
body.zh:
崩溃的地方不是出错的地方。`list_find_by_name` 默认每个节点都有名字，问题是谁存进去了 NULL。条件断点可以回答：`break list_add if name == 0` 只在 `list_add` 被传入 NULL 的 `name` 时才让程序停下，其他时候不会。停下后，`bt` 显示调用者，`frame 1` 选中加载函数。`print row` 说明它正在解析 CSV 的第几行，`print line` 显示这一行的文本。加载函数已经在第二个逗号处截断了字符串，所以 gdb 会在 `3,` 和邮箱之间打印一个 `\000`（NUL 字节）。

这是第 3 行，`3,,noah@example.test`：名字字段为空，而 `contacts_load` 特意把空字段变成 NULL，链表又悄悄接受了它。两个地方遵守同一个约定，却没有任何东西来保证这个约定。

steps.command: gdb -batch -ex 'break list_add if name == 0' -ex run -ex bt -ex 'frame 1' -ex 'print row' -ex 'print line' --args ./contacts contacts.csv Mia Emma

title.en: Write the test that fails on the old code
title.zh: 写一个在旧代码上失败的测试

body.en: Before changing the code, record the bug as a test. The heredoc (`cat > file <<'EOF'`) writes test_list.c in place. It states the rule that was missing: adding a contact without a name must be refused. The `CHECK` macro stops at the first failure and prints the line, so you can see exactly which rule broke. Against the current list code, the second check fails with exit status 1.
body.zh: 改代码之前，先把这个缺陷写成测试。heredoc（`cat > 文件 <<'EOF'`）会就地写出 test_list.c。它写出了原来缺少的规则：添加没有名字的联系人必须被拒绝。`CHECK` 宏在第一次失败时停下并打印行号，所以你能看清是哪条规则被破坏。对现在的链表代码，第二个检查会失败，退出状态为 1。

title.en: Fix the list so the bad state cannot exist
title.zh: 修复链表，让坏状态无法产生

body.en: The patch makes `list_add` refuse a NULL name and also handle a failed copy, which would have produced the same NULL by another route. Now every node in the list has a name, and `list_find_by_name` stays simple and correct. The test passes.
body.zh: 补丁让 `list_add` 拒绝 NULL 名字，同时处理复制失败的情况（复制失败会通过另一条路径产生同样的 NULL）。现在链表里每个节点都有名字，`list_find_by_name` 可以保持简单而正确。测试通过。

title.en: Make the loader report the rejected row
title.zh: 让加载函数报告被拒绝的行

body.en: The loader used to ignore the return value of `list_add`. With the new rule that would drop Noah's row without a word. The patch prints the file and row number to stderr and continues. Rebuild the whole program and run the failing lookup again: Emma is found at last.
body.zh: 加载函数原来忽略了 `list_add` 的返回值。有了新规则，这会不声不响地丢掉 Noah 那一行。补丁把文件名和行号打印到 stderr，然后继续。重新构建整个程序并再次运行刚才失败的查找：终于找到 Emma 了。

steps.command: gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -g -O0 main.c contacts.c list.c -o contacts && ./contacts contacts.csv Mia Emma Noah

review.en: Is the fix applied where the invalid state is created or first accepted, not only where it was observed? A NULL check in the lookup loop would have hidden the bug.
review.zh: 修复是否放在无效状态产生或首次被接受的地方，而不只是在发现它的地方？在查找循环里加一个 NULL 检查只会把缺陷藏起来。

review.en: Is the invariant ("every node has a non-NULL name") written in the header and enforced at one entry point?
review.zh: 不变量（“每个节点都有非 NULL 的名字”）是否写在头文件里，并在唯一的入口处强制执行？

review.en: Is every return value that can signal failure checked? `list_add` returned a status and the caller ignored it.
review.zh: 每个可能表示失败的返回值是否都被检查？`list_add` 返回了状态，调用者却忽略了它。

review.en: Does the new test fail on the old code and pass on the new? A test that never failed has not proven it can catch the bug.
review.zh: 新测试是否在旧代码上失败、在新代码上通过？从未失败过的测试，并没有证明它能抓住这个缺陷。

review.en: When a loader skips bad input, is the skip visible (file and row), counted, and reflected in the exit status or a summary?
review.zh: 加载器跳过坏输入时，这件事是否可见（文件和行号）、有计数，并反映在退出状态或汇总里？

review.en: Does a helper such as `copy_string(NULL) == NULL` hide a caller bug? Prefer the helper that rejects what it should never be given.
review.zh: 像 `copy_string(NULL) == NULL` 这样的辅助函数是否掩盖了调用者的缺陷？宁可用拒绝非法输入的辅助函数。

review.en: Can another reader reproduce the crash from the report: the exact command line, the input file in the repository, and a debug build with -g?
review.zh: 别人能否仅凭报告复现崩溃：准确的命令行、放进仓库的输入文件，以及带 -g 的调试构建？

review.en: Is the data path that created the bad row (a CSV export with an empty name) fixed or documented too?
review.zh: 产生这行坏数据的上游（名字为空的 CSV 导出）是否也修复或记录了？

tradeoffs.en:
**Where to fix.** A NULL check inside `list_find_by_name` is a one-line change that stops this crash. It also lets nameless contacts live in the list, where the next function that touches `name` (sorting, printing, writing a file) needs the same check, and one of them will forget. Refusing at `list_add` costs one branch and a decision about what a rejected row means. The price is that you must now choose between skipping the row, stopping the load, or collecting errors. Skipping with a message, as here, keeps the tool useful but turns bad data into a log line that someone has to read; a batch job should count rejected rows and exit non-zero past a threshold.

**Debugger style.** Batch gdb with a fixed list of `-ex` commands is repeatable, easy to paste into a ticket, and works in CI and over ssh. An interactive session is better when you do not yet know what to look at: you can type `up`, `info locals`, `watch node->name` (a watchpoint that stops when a value changes) and `x/16xb` to examine raw bytes. Prefer the batch form once you know the questions, and keep the command line in the bug report.

**Limits of what you saw.** gdb shows the state at the moment of the signal. Optimised builds (`-O2`) move or drop variables, so `print *node` may say `<optimized out>`, and inlined functions can vanish from the backtrace; debug with `-O0 -g` where you can, and ship separate debug symbols where you cannot. In containers, gdb may warn that it cannot disable address-space randomisation, and attaching to an existing process needs the `SYS_PTRACE` capability. A crash on a machine you cannot attach to is handled with core files: set `ulimit -c unlimited`, let the program crash, then run `gdb -batch -ex bt ./contacts core` (or `coredumpctl gdb` on systemd hosts). A debugger tells you what the state was, not what it should have been; the invariant has to come from reading the code.

**Compared with sanitizers.** A NULL dereference is easy for gdb and for ASan alike. A use of freed memory that happens to look valid is not: gdb will happily show you a struct full of garbage. Run the failing case under AddressSanitizer as well when the crash site does not make sense.
tradeoffs.zh:
**在哪里修。** 在 `list_find_by_name` 里加一个 NULL 检查只改一行，就能挡住这次崩溃。但这也让没有名字的联系人留在链表里，下一个碰 `name` 的函数（排序、打印、写文件）需要同样的检查，总有一个会忘。在 `list_add` 处拒绝的代价是一个分支，外加一个决定：被拒绝的行意味着什么。你必须在跳过该行、停止加载、收集错误三者之间选择。像这里这样带消息地跳过，工具仍然可用，但坏数据变成了需要有人去读的日志；批处理任务应该统计被拒绝的行，超过阈值就以非零状态退出。

**调试器的用法。** 带固定 `-ex` 命令列表的批处理 gdb 可重复、便于贴进工单，在 CI 和 ssh 里也能用。当你还不知道该看什么时，交互式会话更合适：可以输入 `up`、`info locals`、`watch node->name`（数据监视点，值变化时停下）和 `x/16xb`（查看原始字节）。一旦知道要问什么，就改用批处理形式，并把命令行保留在缺陷报告里。

**你看到的有限度。** gdb 展示的是信号发生那一刻的状态。开了优化（`-O2`）的构建会移动或丢弃变量，所以 `print *node` 可能显示 `<optimized out>`，内联函数也可能从回溯里消失；能用 `-O0 -g` 就用，不能的话就单独保存调试符号。在容器里，gdb 可能警告说无法关闭地址空间随机化，附加到已有进程则需要 `SYS_PTRACE` 能力。在无法附加调试器的机器上崩溃，就用核心转储（core file）：设置 `ulimit -c unlimited`，让程序崩溃，然后运行 `gdb -batch -ex bt ./contacts core`（systemd 主机上用 `coredumpctl gdb`）。调试器告诉你状态是什么，但不会告诉你状态应该是什么；不变量只能从阅读代码得到。

**与 sanitizer 对比。** 空指针解引用对 gdb 和 ASan 都很容易。而看上去仍然有效的已释放内存则不然：gdb 会很乐意给你一个充满垃圾的结构体。当崩溃位置说不通时，也要在 AddressSanitizer 下运行失败的用例。

done.en: You can read a backtrace and say which frame is your code and which is the library.
done.zh: 你能读懂回溯，并说出哪一帧是自己的代码、哪一帧是库。

done.en: You can explain why the crashing line (the lookup) was not the line that was wrong (the loader and `list_add`).
done.zh: 你能解释为什么崩溃的那一行（查找）并不是出错的那一行（加载函数和 `list_add`）。

done.en: test_list fails on the original `list_add` and passes after the fix, and `./contacts contacts.csv Mia Emma Noah` runs to the end.
done.zh: test_list 在原来的 `list_add` 上失败、修复后通过，`./contacts contacts.csv Mia Emma Noah` 能完整运行。

done.en: You can write a conditional breakpoint to find who produced a bad value.
done.zh: 你会写条件断点，找出是谁产生了坏值。

title.en: From a loose folder to a build you can trust
title.zh: 从一堆散文件到可信赖的构建

summary.en: Turn a folder with a build.sh into a Makefile with warnings as errors, header dependency tracking, a test target and a sanitizer build, and watch exactly what rebuilds when one header changes.
summary.zh: 把带有 build.sh 的散乱文件夹变成 Makefile：警告当作错误、跟踪头文件依赖、测试目标和 sanitizer 构建，并准确观察改动一个头文件时哪些文件会被重新构建。

scenario.en:
Emma has inherited a small sampler: a ring buffer of the last 16 readings, a function that summarises them, and a hash that picks a shard. It builds with a two-line build.sh that compiles everything every time, has no warning flags, and runs its tests by hand. Last month someone changed a struct in a header, rebuilt only part of the program, and spent a day chasing a crash that disappeared after a full clean build.

Your job is to replace build.sh with a Makefile the team can trust. You will add it in small steps, and check each one by watching what make actually does: which files it recompiles, what it refuses to build, and what it catches that the plain build never showed.
scenario.zh:
Emma 接手了一个小型采样程序：一个保存最近 16 个读数的环形缓冲区、一个汇总它们的函数，以及一个用来选择分片的哈希。它用只有两行的 build.sh 构建，每次都编译全部文件，没有任何警告选项，测试靠手工运行。上个月有人改了头文件里的一个结构体，只重新构建了一部分程序，结果追了一整天的崩溃，而完整干净构建之后问题就消失了。

你的任务是用团队可以信赖的 Makefile 取代 build.sh。你会分小步加入各项功能，并通过观察 make 实际做了什么来验证每一步：它重新编译了哪些文件，拒绝构建什么，以及它发现了哪些普通构建从未显示的问题。

title.en: See the loose folder work
title.zh: 先看这堆散文件能工作

body.en: `cc` is the system C compiler (gcc on Linux, clang on macOS). `-o` names the output. build.sh compiles four files into `sampler`, and compiles `ring.c`, `stats.c` and `util.c` again for `test_ring`. Nothing is warned about, nothing is remembered between runs, and tests exist only if somebody remembers to run them. `ring.h`, `stats.h` and `util.h` are headers: the module files include them, so they matter to the build even though they are never compiled on their own.
body.zh: `cc` 是系统的 C 编译器（Linux 上是 gcc，macOS 上是 clang）。`-o` 指定输出文件名。build.sh 把四个文件编译成 `sampler`，又把 `ring.c`、`stats.c` 和 `util.c` 为 `test_ring` 重新编译一遍。它不给任何警告，运行之间什么也不记住，测试只有在有人想起来的时候才会运行。`ring.h`、`stats.h` 和 `util.h` 是头文件：各模块文件会包含它们，所以它们对构建很重要，尽管它们从不单独编译。

title.en: Translate it to a Makefile and find the first problem
title.zh: 翻译成 Makefile，并发现第一个问题

body.en:
The Makefile is a direct translation. A rule has the form `target: prerequisites`, followed by a tab-indented command. make rebuilds a target when any prerequisite is newer than it. The pattern rule `build/%.o: %.c` says how to turn any `.c` into an object in `build/`, and `$@` and `$<` are the target and the first prerequisite. `make clean` removes the previous output, then `make` builds everything.

The second `make` does nothing, which is correct. Then `touch ring.h` updates the file's time as if it had been edited, and make still does nothing. The rule only lists the `.c` file as a prerequisite, so make cannot know the header matters. This is the dangerous case: edit a struct in `ring.h`, and `main.o` and `stats.o` keep the old layout while `ring.o` could have been rebuilt with the new one. The program builds, links and misbehaves.
body.zh:
Makefile 是直接翻译的。规则的形式是 `目标: 先决条件`，后面跟一条以制表符（tab）缩进的命令。当任一先决条件比目标更新时，make 就重新构建该目标。模式规则 `build/%.o: %.c` 说明如何把任何 `.c` 文件变成 `build/` 里的目标文件，`$@` 和 `$<` 分别是目标和第一个先决条件。`make clean` 删除之前的输出，然后 `make` 构建全部。

第二次 `make` 什么也没做，这是对的。接着 `touch ring.h` 把文件时间更新得就像被编辑过一样，make 仍然什么也不做。规则里只把 `.c` 文件列为先决条件，所以 make 无从知道头文件也有影响。这就是危险的情况：修改 `ring.h` 里的结构体后，`main.o` 和 `stats.o` 仍然保留旧的布局，而 `ring.o` 可能已用新布局重建。程序能构建、能链接，但行为错误。

steps.command: make clean && make && make; touch ring.h; make

title.en: Ask the compiler to write the dependencies
title.zh: 让编译器写出依赖关系

body.en:
The patch adds `-MMD -MP` to the compile flags, together with a baseline: `-std=c11` fixes the language version, `-g` keeps debug information, and `-O2` turns on optimisation. `-MMD` makes the compiler write a small makefile fragment beside each object, listing every non-system header that file included. Look at `build/stats.d`: it says `stats.o` depends on `stats.c`, `stats.h` and `ring.h`. `-MP` adds an empty rule for each header, so deleting a header does not stop the build with "No rule to make target".

Yet `touch ring.h` still triggers nothing. The `.d` files exist but nobody has read them. That is the next step.
body.zh:
补丁在编译选项里加入 `-MMD -MP`，同时加上一组基线选项：`-std=c11` 固定语言版本，`-g` 保留调试信息，`-O2` 打开优化。`-MMD` 让编译器在每个目标文件旁边写出一小段 makefile 片段，列出该文件包含过的所有非系统头文件。看一下 `build/stats.d`：它说 `stats.o` 依赖 `stats.c`、`stats.h` 和 `ring.h`。`-MP` 为每个头文件添加一条空规则，这样删掉某个头文件时，构建不会因为“No rule to make target”而停止。

但 `touch ring.h` 仍然没有触发任何东西。`.d` 文件已经存在，却没有人读取它们。这就是下一步。

steps.command: make clean && make > /dev/null && cat build/stats.d && touch ring.h && make

title.en: Include the dependency files and touch one header
title.zh: 包含依赖文件，再改动一个头文件

body.en:
`-include` reads the `.d` files into the Makefile. The leading dash means "ignore it if the file is missing", which is true on the very first build. The line goes after the first rule, because a `.d` file contains a rule, and a rule above `all` would become the default goal.

Now `touch ring.h` rebuilds exactly the files that include it, directly or through `stats.h`: `ring`, `stats`, `main` and `test_ring`. It does not rebuild `util.c`, which never includes it. The `if grep` line records that fact, so you do not have to look for a missing line in the output. (`sleep 1` makes sure the header is newer than the objects even on systems that compare times in whole seconds. A real edit is always later than the build, so you will not need it.)
body.zh:
`-include` 把 `.d` 文件读进 Makefile。前面的短横线表示“文件不存在就忽略”，第一次构建时正是这种情况。这一行要放在第一条规则之后，因为 `.d` 文件里含有规则，如果放在 `all` 之前，那条规则就会变成默认目标。

现在 `touch ring.h` 恰好重建包含它的文件（直接包含，或通过 `stats.h` 间接包含）：`ring`、`stats`、`main` 和 `test_ring`。它不会重建 `util.c`，因为 `util.c` 从不包含它。`if grep` 那一行把这件事记录下来，你不必在输出里去找缺了哪一行。（`sleep 1` 保证头文件比目标文件新，即使系统只按整秒比较时间也是如此。真实的修改总是晚于构建，所以你平时不需要它。）

steps.command: make clean && make > /dev/null && sleep 1 && touch ring.h && make | tee rebuild.log; if grep -q util.c rebuild.log; then echo "util.c was rebuilt"; else echo "util.c was not rebuilt"; fi

patch.to:
# Read the dependency files the compiler wrote (-MMD). The dash ignores
# missing ones. Keep this below the first rule so no .d file becomes the default goal.
-include $(OBJS:.o=.d) $(TEST_OBJS:.o=.d)

clean:
	rm -rf build build-asan

title.en: Turn warnings into errors
title.zh: 把警告变成错误

body.en:
`-Wall -Wextra` turns on the common warnings, and `-Werror` makes each one stop the build, so warnings cannot pile up unread. Changing flags does not make make rebuild, because the Makefile did not say that objects depend on flags. That is why the command starts with `make clean`. `-k` (keep going) builds every file it can and reports all the errors at once, instead of stopping at the first.

The code has compiled without a word for as long as nobody asked. Two things show up: `main` takes `argc` and `argv` and ignores both, and `stats.c` compares a signed `int` with a `size_t`. The second can change the answer: a negative `int` is converted to a huge unsigned number before the comparison. The message wording differs between compilers (gcc and clang), but the warning name in square brackets is the same.
body.zh:
`-Wall -Wextra` 打开常用的警告，`-Werror` 让每一条警告都使构建失败，这样警告就不会堆积而无人阅读。改变编译选项并不会让 make 重新构建，因为 Makefile 没有声明目标文件依赖于编译选项。所以命令以 `make clean` 开头。`-k`（keep going，继续）会构建所有能构建的文件，一次报告全部错误，而不是在第一个错误处停止。

只要没人去问，这些代码一直编译得悄无声息。现在暴露了两处：`main` 接收了 `argc` 和 `argv` 却都没用；`stats.c` 把有符号的 `int` 和 `size_t` 做比较。后者可能改变结果：负的 `int` 在比较之前会被转成一个巨大的无符号数。不同编译器（gcc 和 clang）的消息措辞不同，但方括号里的警告名称是一样的。

title.en: Fix the first warning
title.zh: 修复第一个警告

body.en: `main` does not use its arguments, so it should say so: `int main(void)`. Fix it and run `make -k` again. The remaining error is the signed comparison in `stats.c`. Do not silence warnings with `-Wno-...` unless you can explain why the code is correct: the fix is almost always shorter than the excuse.
body.zh: `main` 不使用它的参数，所以应当明说：`int main(void)`。修好之后再运行 `make -k`。剩下的错误是 `stats.c` 里的有符号比较。除非你能解释清楚代码为什么正确，否则不要用 `-Wno-...` 压制警告：修复几乎总比借口更短。

title.en: Fix the second warning and build
title.zh: 修复第二个警告并构建

body.en: The loop counter becomes a `size_t`, the same type as `n`, and the cast disappears. The build now succeeds with all warnings on. make only recompiled `stats.c`, because it is the only file that changed. The other objects were built a moment ago in the last step and are up to date.
body.zh: 循环计数器改为 `size_t`，与 `n` 类型一致，类型转换也不再需要。现在带着全部警告选项构建成功。make 只重新编译了 `stats.c`，因为只有它改变了；其他目标文件是上一步刚刚构建的，仍然是最新的。
